examples.pinyin: Yàoshi yǒu shì jiù jiào wǒ, wǒ yìzhí zài pángbiān.
examples.en: Call me if you need anything, I'll be right beside you.

examples.zh: 你知道这条河叫什么名字吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhè tiáo hé jiào shénme míngzi ma?
examples.en: Do you know the name of this river?

examples.zh: 他叫服务员再拿一双筷子。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào fúwùyuán zài ná yì shuāng kuàizi.
examples.en: He asked the waiter to bring another pair of chopsticks.

title: "去" fiilinin kullanımı
summary: "去" (qù) bir yere gitmeyi anlatır: 我去学校 = Okula gidiyorum. Konuşandan uzağa doğru hareketi belirtir.
explanation: "去", konuşan kişiden uzaklaşan bir hareketi anlatır ("来" lái tam tersi, konuşana doğru gelmeyi). Kalıp: Özne + 去 + yer. Ayrıca "去" + fiil kalıbıyla "bir şey yapmaya gitmek" anlamı verir: 我去买东西 (alışverişe gidiyorum). Yerden sonra amaç fiili gelebilir. Olumsuzu "不去" (gitmiyorum) veya geçmiş için "没去" (gitmedim).

examples.zh: 我下午要去图书馆借几本书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù túshūguǎn jiè jǐ běn shū.
examples.en: I'm going to the library this afternoon to borrow some books.

examples.zh: 这个周末你去哪儿玩？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ qù nǎr wán?
examples.en: Where are you going to have fun this weekend?

examples.zh: 他去北京出差了,下周才回来。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù Běijīng chūchāi le, xià zhōu cái huílái.
examples.en: He went to Beijing on business, he won't be back until next week.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我们去公园走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán zǒuzou ba.
examples.en: The weather is so nice, let's go for a walk in the park.

examples.zh: 我妈妈每天早上去市场买菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma měitiān zǎoshang qù shìchǎng mǎi cài.
examples.en: My mom goes to the market to buy vegetables every morning.

examples.zh: 你想去哪个国家旅行？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎge guójiā lǚxíng?
examples.en: Which country do you want to travel to?

examples.zh: 他病了,今天没去上班。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng le, jīntiān méi qù shàngbān.
examples.en: He's sick, so he didn't go to work today.

examples.zh: 我们打算去南方过冬。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn qù nánfāng guòdōng.
examples.en: We plan to go south to spend the winter.

examples.zh: 孩子长大了,要去外地上大学。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhǎngdà le, yào qù wàidì shàng dàxué.
examples.en: The child has grown up and is going to another city for university.

examples.zh: 我这就去,你在这里等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jiù qù, nǐ zài zhèlǐ děng wǒ.
examples.en: I'll go right now, wait for me here.

examples.zh: 下班以后我要去接孩子。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu wǒ yào qù jiē háizi.
examples.en: After work I have to go pick up my child.

examples.zh: 你去过长城吗？听说很壮观。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qùguò Chángchéng ma? Tīngshuō hěn zhuàngguān.
examples.en: Have you been to the Great Wall? I heard it's magnificent.

examples.zh: 我不想一个人去,你陪我去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng yí ge rén qù, nǐ péi wǒ qù ba.
examples.en: I don't want to go alone, come with me.

examples.zh: 他每年都会去看望乡下的爷爷奶奶。
examples.pinyin: Tā měinián dōu huì qù kànwàng xiāngxià de yéye nǎinai.
examples.en: He visits his grandparents in the countryside every year.

examples.zh: 我们先去吃饭,然后去看电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù chīfàn, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: Let's first go eat, then go watch a movie.

examples.zh: 外面下雨了,今天就别去了吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xiàyǔ le, jīntiān jiù bié qù le ba.
examples.en: It's raining outside, let's not go today.

examples.zh: 她去医院看了看生病的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù yīyuàn kàn le kàn shēngbìng de péngyou.
examples.en: She went to the hospital to see her sick friend.

examples.zh: 如果你有空,我们一起去爬山吧。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu kòng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù páshān ba.
examples.en: If you're free, let's go hiking together.

examples.zh: 我去了很多地方,还是觉得家里最好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù le hěn duō dìfang, háishì juéde jiā lǐ zuì hǎo.
examples.en: I've been to many places, but still think home is best.

examples.zh: 他决定去大城市寻找机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng qù dà chéngshì xúnzhǎo jīhuì.
examples.en: He decided to go to the big city to look for opportunities.

examples.zh: 你去哪儿我都跟着你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù nǎr wǒ dōu gēnzhe nǐ.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow you.

examples.zh: 明天我要去参加一个很重要的面试。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ yào qù cānjiā yí ge hěn zhòngyào de miànshì.
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm going to an important interview.

examples.zh: 我们不能总是待在家里,该出去走走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zǒngshì dāi zài jiā lǐ, gāi chūqù zǒuzou le.
examples.en: We can't always stay home, it's time to go out.

examples.zh: 他每天下班后都去健身房锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān xiàbān hòu dōu qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
examples.en: He goes to the gym to work out after work every day.

examples.zh: 这条路我从来没去过,我们看看地图吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ cónglái méi qùguò, wǒmen kànkan dìtú ba.
examples.en: I've never taken this road, let's check the map.

title: "姓" fiilinin kullanımı
summary: "姓" (xìng) soyadı bildirmek için kullanılır: 我姓王 = Soyadım Wang. Sadece soyadı ile birlikte kullanılır.
explanation: "姓" özellikle SOYADI söylemek için kullanılan bir fiildir ve sadece soyad alır — tam ad için "叫" kullanılır. "我姓李" (soyadım Li) doğru, ama "我姓李明" yanlıştır (bu durumda "我叫李明" denir). Soyad sormak için: "您贵姓?" (kibar) veya "你姓什么?". Cevap genellikle "我姓 + soyad" şeklindedir.

examples.zh: 您好,请问您贵姓？
examples.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn nín guìxìng?
examples.en: Hello, may I ask your surname?

examples.zh: 我姓王,叫王小明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xìng Wáng, jiào Wáng Xiǎomíng.
examples.en: My surname is Wang, my name is Wang Xiaoming.

examples.zh: 我们的新老师姓李。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīn lǎoshī xìng Lǐ.
examples.en: Our new teacher's surname is Li.

examples.zh: 他姓张,是我以前的同事。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìng Zhāng, shì wǒ yǐqián de tóngshì.
examples.en: His surname is Zhang, he's my former colleague.

examples.zh: 你姓什么？我好像忘了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xìng shénme? Wǒ hǎoxiàng wàng le.
examples.en: What's your surname? I seem to have forgotten.

examples.zh: 在中国,姓王的人非常多。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, xìng Wáng de rén fēicháng duō.
examples.en: In China, there are very many people surnamed Wang.

examples.zh: 这位客人姓陈,是从上海来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kèrén xìng Chén, shì cóng Shànghǎi lái de.
examples.en: This guest's surname is Chen, he's from Shanghai.

examples.zh: 我爸爸姓刘,我妈妈姓林。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xìng Liú, wǒ māma xìng Lín.
examples.en: My dad's surname is Liu, my mom's is Lin.

examples.zh: 请问那位医生姓什么？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nà wèi yīshēng xìng shénme?
examples.en: May I ask what that doctor's surname is?

examples.zh: 她结婚以后还是用自己原来的姓。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiéhūn yǐhòu háishì yòng zìjǐ yuánlái de xìng.
examples.en: After getting married, she still uses her original surname.

examples.zh: 我们经理姓赵,人很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīnglǐ xìng Zhào, rén hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Our manager's surname is Zhao, he's a nice person.

examples.zh: 孩子一般跟着爸爸姓。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yìbān gēnzhe bàba xìng.
examples.en: Children usually take their father's surname.

examples.zh: 你姓的这个字怎么写？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xìng de zhège zì zěnme xiě?
examples.en: How do you write the character of your surname?

examples.zh: 我认识一个姓周的老先生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi yí ge xìng Zhōu de lǎo xiānsheng.
examples.en: I know an old gentleman surnamed Zhou.

examples.zh: 他不姓王,你可能认错人了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú xìng Wáng, nǐ kěnéng rèncuò rén le.
examples.en: His surname isn't Wang, you might have the wrong person.

examples.zh: 这个村子里的人大部分都姓李。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi lǐ de rén dàbùfen dōu xìng Lǐ.
examples.en: Most people in this village are surnamed Li.

examples.zh: 请问这封信是给一位姓黄的先生的吗？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn zhè fēng xìn shì gěi yí wèi xìng Huáng de xiānsheng de ma?
examples.en: Excuse me, is this letter for a gentleman surnamed Huang?

examples.zh: 我姓的这个姓不太常见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xìng de zhège xìng bú tài chángjiàn.
examples.en: The surname I have is not very common.

examples.zh: 她姓什么我不清楚,只知道叫小雨。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìng shénme wǒ bù qīngchu, zhǐ zhīdào jiào Xiǎoyǔ.
examples.en: I'm not sure of her surname, I only know she's called Xiaoyu.

examples.zh: 老板姓什么并不重要,重要的是他公不公平。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xìng shénme bìng bú zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì tā gōng bu gōngpíng.
examples.en: What the boss's surname is doesn't matter; what matters is whether he's fair.

examples.zh: 很多外国人不知道中国人姓在前,名在后。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō wàiguórén bù zhīdào Zhōngguórén xìng zài qián, míng zài hòu.
examples.en: Many foreigners don't know that Chinese put the surname first and given name last.

examples.zh: 他自我介绍说他姓孙。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìwǒ jièshào shuō tā xìng Sūn.
examples.en: He introduced himself and said his surname is Sun.

examples.zh: 你父亲姓什么,你就跟着姓什么。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fùqīn xìng shénme, nǐ jiù gēnzhe xìng shénme.
examples.en: Whatever your father's surname is, you take the same.

examples.zh: 这位姓吴的作家写了很多有名的书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xìng Wú de zuòjiā xiě le hěn duō yǒumíng de shū.
examples.en: This writer surnamed Wu has written many famous books.

examples.zh: 我不记得他姓什么了,只记得他很高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú jìde tā xìng shénme le, zhǐ jìde tā hěn gāo.
examples.en: I don't remember his surname, only that he was very tall.

title: "能" ile yetenek veya olasılık
summary: "能" (néng) fiziksel yetenek, koşullara bağlı imkân veya izin anlamında "...ebilmek" verir: 我能游泳 = Yüzebilirim.
explanation: "能" "-ebilmek" anlamında yardımcı fiildir ve üç durumu kapsar: (1) fiziksel/durumsal yetenek (你能搬这个箱子吗? - bu kutuyu taşıyabilir misin?), (2) koşullara bağlı imkân (今天太忙,我不能来 - bugün çok meşgulüm, gelemem), (3) izin (这里能抽烟吗? - burada sigara içilebilir mi?). Sonradan öğrenilen beceri için "会" (huì), izin için "可以" (kěyǐ) tercih edilir; bunlar zaman zaman örtüşür.

examples.zh: 中文这么难,你能学好吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwén zhème nán, nǐ néng xuéhǎo ma?
examples.en: Chinese is so hard, can you master it?

examples.zh: 对不起,我今天太忙了,不能陪你。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ jīntiān tài máng le, bù néng péi nǐ.
examples.en: Sorry, I'm too busy today, I can't keep you company.

examples.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子搬上楼吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhège xiāngzi bān shàng lóu ma?
examples.en: Can you help me carry this box upstairs?

examples.zh: 生病的时候不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhou bù néng hējiǔ.
examples.en: You can't drink alcohol when you're sick.

examples.zh: 只要努力,你一定能成功。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǔlì, nǐ yídìng néng chénggōng.
examples.en: As long as you work hard, you'll surely succeed.

examples.zh: 这么重要的会议你怎么能迟到？
examples.pinyin: Zhème zhòngyào de huìyì nǐ zěnme néng chídào?
examples.en: How could you be late for such an important meeting?

examples.zh: 我明天能不能请一天假？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān néng bu néng qǐng yì tiān jià?
examples.en: Can I take a day off tomorrow?

examples.zh: 他受伤了,现在还不能走路。
examples.pinyin: Tā shòushāng le, xiànzài hái bù néng zǒulù.
examples.en: He's injured and can't walk yet.

examples.zh: 你能听懂他说的方言吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng tīngdǒng tā shuō de fāngyán ma?
examples.en: Can you understand the dialect he speaks?

examples.zh: 只有互相理解,我们才能一起走下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu hùxiāng lǐjiě, wǒmen cái néng yìqǐ zǒu xiàqù.
examples.en: Only by understanding each other can we keep going together.

examples.zh: 这个时间我恐怕不能到,路上太堵了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíjiān wǒ kǒngpà bù néng dào, lùshang tài dǔ le.
examples.en: I'm afraid I can't make it by then, the traffic is too heavy.

examples.zh: 你能不能小声一点？孩子在睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng xiǎoshēng yìdiǎn? Háizi zài shuìjiào.
examples.en: Can you be a bit quieter? The child is sleeping.

examples.zh: 人不能只想着自己。
examples.pinyin: Rén bù néng zhǐ xiǎngzhe zìjǐ.
examples.en: A person can't just think about themselves.

examples.zh: 我们能做的都做了,剩下的只能等。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zuò de dōu zuò le, shèngxià de zhǐ néng děng.
examples.en: We've done all we can, all that's left is to wait.

examples.zh: 这个秘密你能替我保守吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège mìmì nǐ néng tì wǒ bǎoshǒu ma?
examples.en: Can you keep this secret for me?

examples.zh: 再给我一点时间,我一定能做得更好。
examples.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒ yìdiǎn shíjiān, wǒ yídìng néng zuò de gèng hǎo.
examples.en: Give me a little more time, I can surely do better.

examples.zh: 这么晚了,你一个人能回家吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, nǐ yí ge rén néng huíjiā ma?
examples.en: It's so late, can you get home by yourself?

examples.zh: 我们不能让这样的事情再次发生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng ràng zhèyàng de shìqing zàicì fāshēng.
examples.en: We can't let something like this happen again.

examples.zh: 你能想到这一点,说明你很细心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng xiǎngdào zhè yìdiǎn, shuōmíng nǐ hěn xìxīn.
examples.en: That you could think of this shows you're very attentive.

examples.zh: 钱能解决的问题都不算大问题。
examples.pinyin: Qián néng jiějué de wèntí dōu bú suàn dà wèntí.
examples.en: Problems that money can solve aren't really big problems.

examples.zh: 没有你的帮助,我不可能完成这件事。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒ bù kěnéng wánchéng zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Without your help, I couldn't have finished this.

examples.zh: 他病得很重,能不能好起来还不知道。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng de hěn zhòng, néng bu néng hǎo qǐlái hái bù zhīdào.
examples.en: He's very ill, whether he can recover is still unknown.

examples.zh: 你放心,我能照顾好自己。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ néng zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ.
examples.en: Don't worry, I can take care of myself.

examples.zh: 这么小的字,我不戴眼镜看不清。
examples.pinyin: Zhème xiǎo de zì, wǒ bú dài yǎnjìng kàn bu qīng.
examples.en: Such small characters, I can't see clearly without glasses.

examples.zh: 我们能走到今天,真的很不容易。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zǒudào jīntiān, zhēn de hěn bù róngyì.
examples.en: That we could make it this far really wasn't easy.

title: "会" ile öğrenilmiş beceri
summary: "会" (huì) öğrenme sonucu kazanılan bir beceriyi anlatır: 我会说中文 = Çince konuşabilirim (öğrendim).
explanation: "会" özellikle SONRADAN ÖĞRENİLEN beceriler için kullanılır: dil konuşmak, yüzmek, araba kullanmak, yemek yapmak. "能"'den farkı budur — "能" genel yetenek/imkân, "会" ise öğrenilmiş ustalıktır. Olumsuzu "不会". Ayrıca "会" gelecekte bir şeyin olma olasılığını da anlatır: 明天会下雨 (yarın yağmur yağacak) — bu ayrı bir kullanımdır.

examples.zh: 我会说三种语言。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán.
examples.en: I can speak three languages.

examples.zh: 他不会游泳,你别让他下水。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì yóuyǒng, nǐ bié ràng tā xiàshuǐ.
examples.en: He can't swim, don't let him go into the water.

examples.zh: 你会不会开车？我们需要一个司机。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì bu huì kāichē? Wǒmen xūyào yí ge sījī.
examples.en: Can you drive? We need a driver.

examples.zh: 我妈妈会做很多好吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma huì zuò hěn duō hǎochī de cài.
examples.en: My mom can make many delicious dishes.

examples.zh: 这个孩子五岁就会弹钢琴了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi wǔ suì jiù huì tán gāngqín le.
examples.en: This child could play the piano at five.

examples.zh: 以前我不会用筷子,现在很熟练了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ bú huì yòng kuàizi, xiànzài hěn shúliàn le.
examples.en: I couldn't use chopsticks before, now I'm quite skilled.

examples.zh: 她会画画,也会写诗。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì huàhuà, yě huì xiě shī.
examples.en: She can paint and also write poetry.

examples.zh: 我还不太会做这道菜,你能教我吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái bú tài huì zuò zhè dào cài, nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.en: I don't really know how to make this dish, can you teach me?

examples.zh: 学了一年以后,他终于会用中文写信了。
examples.pinyin: Xué le yì nián yǐhòu, tā zhōngyú huì yòng Zhōngwén xiěxìn le.
examples.en: After a year of study, he can finally write letters in Chinese.

examples.zh: 你会不会觉得我问得太多了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì bu huì juéde wǒ wèn de tài duō le?
examples.en: Do you feel that I'm asking too much?

examples.zh: 只要用心,谁都会做好这件事。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào yòngxīn, shéi dōu huì zuòhǎo zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: As long as one puts their heart into it, anyone can do this well.

examples.zh: 他会好几种乐器,真让人羡慕。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì hǎojǐ zhǒng yuèqì, zhēn ràng rén xiànmù.
examples.en: He can play several instruments, really enviable.

examples.zh: 这么简单的字你怎么会不会写？
examples.pinyin: Zhème jiǎndān de zì nǐ zěnme huì bú huì xiě?
examples.en: How can you not know how to write such a simple character?

examples.zh: 我相信努力练习,你一定会成功。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǔlì liànxí, nǐ yídìng huì chénggōng.
examples.en: I believe that with hard practice, you'll surely succeed.

examples.zh: 她会跳很多种舞,芭蕾跳得最好。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tiào hěn duō zhǒng wǔ, bālěi tiào de zuì hǎo.
examples.en: She can dance many styles, and does ballet best.

examples.zh: 孩子小时候学的东西,长大了也不会忘。
examples.pinyin: Háizi xiǎoshíhou xué de dōngxi, zhǎngdà le yě bú huì wàng.
examples.en: What children learn when young, they won't forget when grown.

examples.zh: 你会用这个新软件吗？我完全不懂。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì yòng zhège xīn ruǎnjiàn ma? Wǒ wánquán bù dǒng.
examples.en: Do you know how to use this new software? I have no idea.

examples.zh: 他不会拒绝别人,总是答应帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì jùjué biérén, zǒngshì dāying bāngmáng.
examples.en: He can't say no to people, always agrees to help.

examples.zh: 会说和会写是两回事。
examples.pinyin: Huì shuō hé huì xiě shì liǎng huí shì.
examples.en: Being able to speak and being able to write are two different things.

examples.zh: 我小时候会骑马,现在都忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou huì qímǎ, xiànzài dōu wàng le.
examples.en: I could ride a horse as a child, now I've forgotten how.

examples.zh: 这种技术不是每个人都会的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jìshù bú shì měi ge rén dōu huì de.
examples.en: This skill is not something everyone has.

examples.zh: 她会好几门外语,工作起来很方便。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì hǎojǐ mén wàiyǔ, gōngzuò qǐlái hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.en: She knows several foreign languages, which makes work convenient.

examples.zh: 只有真正热爱,你才会一直坚持下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng rè'ài, nǐ cái huì yìzhí jiānchí xiàqù.
examples.en: Only if you truly love it will you keep at it.

examples.zh: 我不会忘记你对我的好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì wàngjì nǐ duì wǒ de hǎo.
examples.en: I won't forget how good you've been to me.

examples.zh: 他做饭很好吃,可是不会收拾厨房。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòfàn hěn hǎochī, kěshì bú huì shōushi chúfáng.
examples.en: He cooks delicious food, but doesn't know how to clean up the kitchen.

title: "要" ile "...ecek/...acak" (gelecek/niyet)
summary: "要" (yào) yakın gelecekte yapılacak/olacak bir eylemi anlatır: 我要去北京 = Pekin'e gideceğim.
explanation: "要", planlanmış veya yakında olacak bir eylemi ifade eder ("...ecek"). Genellikle cümle sonuna "了" eklenerek eylemin çok yakın olduğu vurgulanır: 火车要开了 (tren kalkmak üzere). Olumsuz gelecek için "要" değil "不" kullanılır: 我明天不去 (yarın gitmeyeceğim). "要" ayrıca "istemek" (bir sonraki konu) ve "gerekmek" anlamlarına da gelir; bağlam ayırt eder.

examples.zh: 快点儿,火车要开了！
examples.pinyin: Kuài diǎnr, huǒchē yào kāi le!
examples.en: Hurry up, the train is about to leave!

examples.zh: 我下个月要去日本旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yào qù Rìběn lǚxíng.
examples.en: I'm going to travel to Japan next month.

examples.zh: 天要黑了,我们该回家了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān yào hēi le, wǒmen gāi huíjiā le.
examples.en: It's getting dark, we should head home.

examples.zh: 他明年要结婚了,大家都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngnián yào jiéhūn le, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.en: He's getting married next year, everyone is happy.

examples.zh: 看样子要下雨了,你带伞了吗？
examples.pinyin: Kàn yàngzi yào xiàyǔ le, nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
examples.en: It looks like it's going to rain, did you bring an umbrella?

examples.zh: 我们要搬家了,以后见面的机会不多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào bānjiā le, yǐhòu jiànmiàn de jīhuì bù duō le.
examples.en: We're moving, so we won't get to meet often anymore.

examples.zh: 孩子明年就要上小学了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi míngnián jiù yào shàng xiǎoxué le.
examples.en: The child is going to start primary school next year.

examples.zh: 我要努力工作,给家人更好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào nǔlì gōngzuò, gěi jiārén gèng hǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.en: I'm going to work hard to give my family a better life.

examples.zh: 电影要开始了,快把手机关了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng yào kāishǐ le, kuài bǎ shǒujī guān le.
examples.en: The movie is about to start, turn off your phone.

examples.zh: 他说他要来,可是到现在还没到。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā yào lái, kěshì dào xiànzài hái méi dào.
examples.en: He said he'd come, but he still hasn't arrived.

examples.zh: 春天要到了,树上开始长新叶子了。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān yào dào le, shù shàng kāishǐ zhǎng xīn yèzi le.
examples.en: Spring is coming, new leaves are growing on the trees.

examples.zh: 我要在这个城市重新开始我的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài zhège chéngshì chóngxīn kāishǐ wǒ de shēnghuó.
examples.en: I'm going to start my life anew in this city.

examples.zh: 考试要到了,我得抓紧时间复习。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì yào dào le, wǒ děi zhuājǐn shíjiān fùxí.
examples.en: The exam is coming, I have to hurry and review.

examples.zh: 你要走了吗？再坐一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zǒu le ma? Zài zuò yíhuìr ba.
examples.en: Are you leaving? Sit a while longer.

examples.zh: 这本书我快要看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kuài yào kànwán le.
examples.en: I'm almost finished reading this book.

examples.zh: 公司要开一个重要的会议,大家都得参加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yào kāi yí ge zhòngyào de huìyì, dàjiā dōu děi cānjiā.
examples.en: The company is going to hold an important meeting, everyone must attend.

examples.zh: 我们的假期要结束了,真舍不得。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàqī yào jiéshù le, zhēn shěbùdé.
examples.en: Our vacation is ending, I really don't want it to.

examples.zh: 他要退休了,同事们给他准备了礼物。
examples.pinyin: Tā yào tuìxiū le, tóngshìmen gěi tā zhǔnbèi le lǐwù.
examples.en: He's retiring, and his colleagues prepared a gift for him.

examples.zh: 我明天一早要出发,今晚得早点睡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yìzǎo yào chūfā, jīnwǎn děi zǎodiǎn shuì.
examples.en: I'm leaving early tomorrow, so I need to sleep early tonight.

examples.zh: 看他的样子,好像要哭了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn tā de yàngzi, hǎoxiàng yào kū le.
examples.en: By the look of him, it seems he's about to cry.

examples.zh: 我们的孩子要长大了,时间过得真快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de háizi yào zhǎngdà le, shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài.
examples.en: Our child is growing up, time really flies.

examples.zh: 你要去哪儿？我送你一程吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào qù nǎr? Wǒ sòng nǐ yì chéng ba.
examples.en: Where are you going? Let me give you a ride part of the way.

examples.zh: 新的一年要开始了,祝你一切顺利。
examples.pinyin: Xīn de yì nián yào kāishǐ le, zhù nǐ yíqiè shùnlì.
examples.en: A new year is beginning, I wish you all the best.

examples.zh: 雨要停了,天空慢慢亮了起来。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yào tíng le, tiānkōng mànman liàng le qǐlái.
examples.en: The rain is about to stop, the sky is slowly brightening.

examples.zh: 我快要坚持不住了,可是我不想放弃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kuài yào jiānchí bú zhù le, kěshì wǒ bù xiǎng fàngqì.
examples.en: I'm about to reach my limit, but I don't want to give up.

title: "可以" ile izin
summary: "可以" (kěyǐ) izin verme veya izin isteme anlamında "...ebilir / ...abilir miyim" verir: 我可以进来吗？ = İçeri girebilir miyim?
explanation: "可以" ağırlıklı olarak İZİN bildirir: "这里可以拍照" (burada fotoğraf çekilebilir). İzin istemek için soru yapılır: "我可以坐这里吗?" (buraya oturabilir miyim?). Kısaca izin vermek için sadece "可以" denir. Olumsuz/yasak için genellikle "不可以" ya da "不能" kullanılır. "可以" ayrıca imkân ve "fena değil/iyi" anlamlarına da gelebilir.

examples.zh: 请问,我可以坐这里吗？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèlǐ ma?
examples.en: Excuse me, may I sit here?

examples.zh: 这个博物馆里不可以拍照。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bówùguǎn lǐ bù kěyǐ pāizhào.
examples.en: You can't take photos in this museum.

examples.zh: 你可以用我的电脑,密码是我的生日。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de diànnǎo, mìmǎ shì wǒ de shēngri.
examples.en: You can use my computer, the password is my birthday.

examples.zh: 孩子做完作业以后可以看一会儿电视。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zuòwán zuòyè yǐhòu kěyǐ kàn yíhuìr diànshì.
examples.en: The child can watch TV for a while after finishing homework.

examples.zh: 这里可以抽烟吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kěyǐ chōuyān ma?
examples.en: Can I smoke here?

examples.zh: 你可以慢慢想,不用着急回答。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ mànman xiǎng, búyòng zháojí huídá.
examples.en: You can take your time, no need to answer in a hurry.

examples.zh: 这张票一个人可以带一个孩子进去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào yí ge rén kěyǐ dài yí ge háizi jìnqù.
examples.en: With this ticket one person can bring one child in.

examples.zh: 如果你不舒服,可以先回去休息。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù shūfu, kěyǐ xiān huíqù xiūxi.
examples.en: If you're not feeling well, you can go back and rest.

examples.zh: 这件事你可以问问经理的意见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ kěyǐ wènwen jīnglǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.en: You can ask the manager's opinion about this.

examples.zh: 对不起,这个座位已经有人了,你不可以坐。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, zhège zuòwèi yǐjīng yǒu rén le, nǐ bù kěyǐ zuò.
examples.en: Sorry, this seat is taken, you can't sit here.

examples.zh: 你可以相信我,我不会告诉别人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ xiāngxìn wǒ, wǒ bú huì gàosù biérén.
examples.en: You can trust me, I won't tell anyone.

examples.zh: 我们可以换个地方谈吗？这里太吵了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ huàn ge dìfang tán ma? Zhèlǐ tài chǎo le.
examples.en: Can we talk somewhere else? It's too noisy here.

examples.zh: 这种药一天可以吃两次。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào yì tiān kěyǐ chī liǎng cì.
examples.en: This medicine can be taken twice a day.

examples.zh: 你可以试一试,不试怎么知道行不行？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ shì yi shì, bú shì zěnme zhīdào xíng bu xíng?
examples.en: You can give it a try; how will you know if it works without trying?

examples.zh: 这里的书可以借回家看。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de shū kěyǐ jiè huíjiā kàn.
examples.en: The books here can be borrowed and taken home to read.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,不可以一个人过马路。
examples.pinyin: Háizi hái xiǎo, bù kěyǐ yí ge rén guò mǎlù.
examples.en: The child is still young and can't cross the road alone.

examples.zh: 你可以告诉我发生了什么事吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gàosù wǒ fāshēng le shénme shì ma?
examples.en: Can you tell me what happened?

examples.zh: 这个价钱还可以,我们买下来吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàqián hái kěyǐ, wǒmen mǎi xiàlái ba.
examples.en: This price is okay, let's buy it.

examples.zh: 你随时可以给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ suíshí kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: You can call me anytime.

examples.zh: 这些资料你可以拿去用,不用还给我。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zīliào nǐ kěyǐ ná qù yòng, búyòng huán gěi wǒ.
examples.en: You can take these materials to use, no need to return them.

examples.zh: 人可以失败,但是不可以放弃。
examples.pinyin: Rén kěyǐ shībài, dànshì bù kěyǐ fàngqì.
examples.en: A person can fail, but must not give up.

examples.zh: 你今天可以早点走,剩下的我来做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān kěyǐ zǎodiǎn zǒu, shèngxià de wǒ lái zuò.
examples.en: You can leave early today, I'll do the rest.

examples.zh: 这条河夏天可以游泳,冬天可以滑冰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé xiàtiān kěyǐ yóuyǒng, dōngtiān kěyǐ huábīng.
examples.en: You can swim in this river in summer and skate on it in winter.

examples.zh: 有问题的话,你可以随时来找我。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèntí dehuà, nǐ kěyǐ suíshí lái zhǎo wǒ.
examples.en: If you have questions, you can come to me anytime.

examples.zh: 这件事我一个人可以处理,你放心吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yí ge rén kěyǐ chǔlǐ, nǐ fàngxīn ba.
examples.en: I can handle this on my own, don't worry.

title: "要" ile bir şey isteme
summary: "要" (yào) bir şeyi istemek/talep etmek anlamında da kullanılır: 我要一杯水 = Bir bardak su istiyorum.
explanation: "要", gelecek anlamının yanı sıra güçlü bir istek/talep de bildirir. İsimle: "我要一杯咖啡" (bir kahve istiyorum) — sipariş verirken çok yaygındır. Fiille: "我要学中文" (Çince öğrenmek istiyorum). "想" (xiǎng) daha yumuşak bir istek/arzu bildirir; "要" daha kararlı/kesindir. "要"'nun olumsuzu istek anlamında "不想" veya "不要" olabilir (bağlama göre).

examples.zh: 服务员,我要一份牛肉面。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, wǒ yào yí fèn niúròu miàn.
examples.en: Waiter, I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.

examples.zh: 我要好好学习,将来做一个有用的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào hǎohǎo xuéxí, jiānglái zuò yí ge yǒuyòng de rén.
examples.en: I want to study hard and become a useful person in the future.

examples.zh: 你要不要跟我们一起去看电影？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng?
examples.en: Do you want to come watch a movie with us?

examples.zh: 孩子哭着要妈妈抱他。
examples.pinyin: Háizi kūzhe yào māma bào tā.
examples.en: The child is crying and wants mom to hold him.

examples.zh: 我要的不多,只要一家人平平安安。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào de bù duō, zhǐ yào yìjiā rén píngpíng'ān'ān.
examples.en: I don't want much, just for my family to be safe and sound.

examples.zh: 他要这个,不要那个,真难伺候。
examples.pinyin: Tā yào zhège, bú yào nàge, zhēn nán cìhou.
examples.en: He wants this, not that, really hard to please.

examples.zh: 我要成为一名医生,帮助更多的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào chéngwéi yì míng yīshēng, bāngzhù gèng duō de rén.
examples.en: I want to become a doctor and help more people.

examples.zh: 你要几个苹果？我给你拿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào jǐ ge píngguǒ? Wǒ gěi nǐ ná.
examples.en: How many apples do you want? I'll get them for you.

examples.zh: 我要一个人静一静,请别打扰我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào yí ge rén jìng yi jìng, qǐng bié dǎrǎo wǒ.
examples.en: I want to be alone and quiet, please don't disturb me.

examples.zh: 你到底要什么,能不能说清楚？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ yào shénme, néng bu néng shuō qīngchu?
examples.en: What exactly do you want, can you make it clear?

examples.zh: 他要请我们全家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā yào qǐng wǒmen quánjiā chīfàn.
examples.en: He wants to treat our whole family to a meal.

examples.zh: 我不要别的,只要你陪着我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú yào biéde, zhǐ yào nǐ péizhe wǒ.
examples.en: I don't want anything else, just for you to be with me.

examples.zh: 这么大的事,我要好好想一想。
examples.pinyin: Zhème dà de shì, wǒ yào hǎohǎo xiǎng yi xiǎng.
examples.en: Such a big matter, I want to think it over carefully.

examples.zh: 你要买什么就买什么,别在意钱。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào mǎi shénme jiù mǎi shénme, bié zàiyì qián.
examples.en: Buy whatever you want, don't worry about the money.

examples.zh: 我要向你道歉,那天是我不对。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, nà tiān shì wǒ búduì.
examples.en: I want to apologize to you, I was wrong that day.

examples.zh: 孩子长大了,要有自己的空间。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhǎngdà le, yào yǒu zìjǐ de kōngjiān.
examples.en: As children grow up, they need their own space.

examples.zh: 你要是想学,我可以教你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi xiǎng xué, wǒ kěyǐ jiāo nǐ.
examples.en: If you want to learn, I can teach you.

examples.zh: 我要谢谢所有帮助过我的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào xièxie suǒyǒu bāngzhùguò wǒ de rén.
examples.en: I want to thank everyone who has helped me.

examples.zh: 他什么都要最好的,可是又不肯努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā shénme dōu yào zuì hǎo de, kěshì yòu bù kěn nǔlì.
examples.en: He wants the best of everything, but isn't willing to work hard.

examples.zh: 我要的很简单,就是每天开开心心的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào de hěn jiǎndān, jiùshì měitiān kāikāixīnxīn de.
examples.en: What I want is simple: just to be happy every day.

examples.zh: 你要注意身体,别太累了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhùyì shēntǐ, bié tài lèi le.
examples.en: You should take care of your health, don't overwork.

examples.zh: 这次比赛我一定要拿第一名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐsài wǒ yídìng yào ná dì yī míng.
examples.en: I'm determined to come first in this competition.

examples.zh: 你要的答案其实一直在你心里。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào de dá'àn qíshí yìzhí zài nǐ xīnlǐ.
examples.en: The answer you want has always been in your heart.

examples.zh: 我要感谢父母把我养育成人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào gǎnxiè fùmǔ bǎ wǒ yǎngyù chéngrén.
examples.en: I want to thank my parents for raising me into an adult.

examples.zh: 你要幸福,这是我唯一的愿望。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào xìngfú, zhè shì wǒ wéiyī de yuànwàng.
examples.en: I want you to be happy; that's my only wish.

title: "怎么" ile "nasıl" sorusu
summary: "怎么" (zěnme) bir eylemin nasıl yapıldığını sorar: 怎么走？ = Nasıl gidilir?
explanation: "怎么" fiilin önüne gelerek eylemin YÖNTEMİNİ/BİÇİMİNİ sorar: 这个字怎么写? (bu karakter nasıl yazılır?), 怎么去机场? (havaalanına nasıl gidilir?). Ayrıca "怎么" bir durumun sebebini/şaşkınlığını da ifade edebilir: 你怎么还没睡? (nasıl olur da hâlâ uyumadın?). Bu soru kelimesi de olduğu yerde kalır, cümle başına taşınmaz.

examples.zh: 请问,去火车站怎么走？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu?
examples.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

examples.zh: 这个字怎么写？我总是记不住。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì zěnme xiě? Wǒ zǒngshì jì bu zhù.
examples.en: How do you write this character? I can never remember.

examples.zh: 这道菜怎么做？闻起来真香。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zěnme zuò? Wén qǐlái zhēn xiāng.
examples.en: How is this dish made? It smells so good.

examples.zh: 你怎么知道我今天不开心？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ jīntiān bù kāixīn?
examples.en: How did you know I'm unhappy today?

examples.zh: 这个机器怎么用,你能教教我吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège jīqì zěnme yòng, nǐ néng jiāojiao wǒ ma?
examples.en: How do you use this machine? Can you teach me?

examples.zh: 你怎么才来？我们等你半天了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme cái lái? Wǒmen děng nǐ bàntiān le.
examples.en: How come you're only just arriving? We've waited for ages.

examples.zh: 这个问题应该怎么解决,大家一起想想。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yīnggāi zěnme jiějué, dàjiā yìqǐ xiǎngxiang.
examples.en: How should we solve this problem? Let's all think about it.

examples.zh: 你怎么把这么重要的事忘了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme bǎ zhème zhòngyào de shì wàng le?
examples.en: How could you forget something so important?

examples.zh: 这个词是什么意思,怎么用？
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí shì shénme yìsi, zěnme yòng?
examples.en: What does this word mean, and how is it used?

examples.zh: 我不知道以后的路该怎么走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào yǐhòu de lù gāi zěnme zǒu.
examples.en: I don't know how to proceed from here.

examples.zh: 你怎么一个人在这里,你朋友呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yí ge rén zài zhèlǐ, nǐ péngyou ne?
examples.en: How come you're here alone? Where are your friends?

examples.zh: 这么复杂的事,你是怎么处理的？
examples.pinyin: Zhème fùzá de shì, nǐ shì zěnme chǔlǐ de?
examples.en: How did you handle something so complicated?

examples.zh: 电脑坏了,你知道怎么修吗？
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo huài le, nǐ zhīdào zěnme xiū ma?
examples.en: The computer is broken, do you know how to fix it?

examples.zh: 你怎么突然改变主意了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme tūrán gǎibiàn zhǔyi le?
examples.en: How come you suddenly changed your mind?

examples.zh: 这件事我该怎么跟他说呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gāi zěnme gēn tā shuō ne?
examples.en: How should I tell him about this?

examples.zh: 你们是怎么认识的？给我讲讲。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen shì zěnme rènshi de? Gěi wǒ jiǎngjiang.
examples.en: How did you two meet? Tell me about it.

examples.zh: 外面这么冷,你怎么不多穿点儿？
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn zhème lěng, nǐ zěnme bù duō chuān diǎnr?
examples.en: It's so cold outside, why aren't you wearing more?

examples.zh: 这个游戏怎么玩,规则太复杂了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yóuxì zěnme wán, guīzé tài fùzá le.
examples.en: How do you play this game? The rules are too complex.

examples.zh: 我真不知道该怎么感谢你才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhēn bù zhīdào gāi zěnme gǎnxiè nǐ cái hǎo.
examples.en: I really don't know how to thank you enough.

examples.zh: 你怎么把杯子打破了？没伤到手吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme bǎ bēizi dǎpò le? Méi shāngdào shǒu ba?
examples.en: How did you break the cup? You didn't hurt your hand, did you?

examples.zh: 这么远的路,你打算怎么去？
examples.pinyin: Zhème yuǎn de lù, nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme qù?
examples.en: Such a long way, how do you plan to get there?

examples.zh: 日子再难,也得想办法过下去。你说该怎么办？
examples.pinyin: Rìzi zài nán, yě děi xiǎng bànfǎ guò xiàqù. Nǐ shuō gāi zěnme bàn?
examples.en: However hard life is, we must find a way through. What do you think we should do?

examples.zh: 你怎么看起来这么累,昨晚没睡好吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme kàn qǐlái zhème lèi, zuówǎn méi shuì hǎo ma?
examples.en: How come you look so tired, didn't you sleep well last night?

examples.zh: 我一直在想,这件事到底是怎么发生的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zài xiǎng, zhè jiàn shì dàodǐ shì zěnme fāshēng de.
examples.en: I keep wondering how this actually happened.

examples.zh: 不管怎么说,你都应该先道个歉。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zěnme shuō, nǐ dōu yīnggāi xiān dào ge qiàn.
examples.en: No matter what, you should apologize first.

title: "没有" ile geçmiş eylemin olumsuzu
summary: Geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir eylem "不" ile değil, "没(有)" ile olumsuzlanır: 我没去 = Gitmedim.
explanation: Bir eylemin GERÇEKLEŞMEDİĞİNİ (geçmiş) söylerken "不" değil "没(有)" kullanılır. "我不去" = gitmiyorum/gitmeyeceğim (irade/gelecek), "我没去" = gitmedim (gerçekleşmedi). "没" ile birlikte "了" KULLANILMAZ çünkü eylem tamamlanmamıştır: "我没吃" doğru, "我没吃了" yanlıştır. Konuşmada "有" düşüp sadece "没" kalabilir.

examples.zh: 我昨天没去上班,因为生病了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān méi qù shàngbān, yīnwèi shēngbìng le.
examples.en: I didn't go to work yesterday because I was sick.

examples.zh: 对不起,我没听清楚,你能再说一遍吗？
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu, nǐ néng zài shuō yí biàn ma?
examples.en: Sorry, I didn't hear clearly, can you say it again?

examples.zh: 他一晚上都没睡,眼睛红红的。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì wǎnshang dōu méi shuì, yǎnjing hónghóng de.
examples.en: He didn't sleep all night, his eyes are all red.

examples.zh: 我等了很久,可是她一直没来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le hěn jiǔ, kěshì tā yìzhí méi lái.
examples.en: I waited a long time, but she never came.

examples.zh: 这件事我还没告诉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ hái méi gàosù rènhé rén.
examples.en: I haven't told anyone about this yet.

examples.zh: 你怎么没吃早饭就出门了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme méi chī zǎofàn jiù chūmén le?
examples.en: How did you leave without eating breakfast?

examples.zh: 我给他打了好几次电话,他都没接。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā dǎ le hǎojǐ cì diànhuà, tā dōu méi jiē.
examples.en: I called him several times, but he didn't pick up.

examples.zh: 这么多年过去了,他一点儿也没变。
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō nián guòqù le, tā yìdiǎnr yě méi biàn.
examples.en: After all these years, he hasn't changed a bit.

examples.zh: 我没想到事情会变成这样。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào shìqing huì biànchéng zhèyàng.
examples.en: I didn't expect things would turn out this way.

examples.zh: 作业太多了,我昨晚没做完。
examples.pinyin: Zuòyè tài duō le, wǒ zuówǎn méi zuòwán.
examples.en: There was too much homework, I didn't finish it last night.

examples.zh: 他说他没拿我的书,可是我不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā méi ná wǒ de shū, kěshì wǒ bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.en: He said he didn't take my book, but I don't quite believe it.

examples.zh: 这部电影我一直没机会看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng wǒ yìzhí méi jīhuì kàn.
examples.en: I've never had the chance to watch this movie.

examples.zh: 我们好几年没见了,你都没什么变化。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hǎojǐ nián méi jiàn le, nǐ dōu méi shénme biànhuà.
examples.en: We haven't met in years, and you've hardly changed.

examples.zh: 雨下了一整天都没停。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ xià le yìzhěng tiān dōu méi tíng.
examples.en: It rained all day without stopping.

examples.zh: 我没听说过这个消息,是真的吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīngshuōguò zhège xiāoxi, shì zhēn de ma?
examples.en: I haven't heard this news, is it true?

examples.zh: 他忙得连饭都没顾上吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā máng de lián fàn dōu méi gùshàng chī.
examples.en: He was so busy he didn't even get a chance to eat.

examples.zh: 这次考试我没考好,有点难过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ méi kǎo hǎo, yǒudiǎn nánguò.
examples.en: I didn't do well on this exam, I feel a bit down.

examples.zh: 我没带钱,可以下次再给你吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi dài qián, kěyǐ xià cì zài gěi nǐ ma?
examples.en: I didn't bring money, can I give it to you next time?

examples.zh: 他到最后也没说出自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào zuìhòu yě méi shuōchū zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: In the end he never expressed his own thoughts.

examples.zh: 我一直没勇气告诉她我的感受。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí méi yǒngqì gàosù tā wǒ de gǎnshòu.
examples.en: I never had the courage to tell her how I feel.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会,你怎么没抓住？
examples.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, nǐ zěnme méi zhuāzhù?
examples.en: Such a good chance, how did you not seize it?

examples.zh: 我们那天玩得太开心,都没注意到时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen nà tiān wán de tài kāixīn, dōu méi zhùyìdào shíjiān.
examples.en: We had so much fun that day that we didn't notice the time.

examples.zh: 他病了这么久,一直没好起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng le zhème jiǔ, yìzhí méi hǎo qǐlái.
examples.en: He's been sick for so long and hasn't recovered.

examples.zh: 这本书我买了很久,可是一直没看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ mǎi le hěn jiǔ, kěshì yìzhí méi kàn.
examples.en: I bought this book long ago, but never read it.

examples.zh: 我没做错事,为什么要向他道歉？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi zuòcuò shì, wèishénme yào xiàng tā dàoqiàn?
examples.en: I didn't do anything wrong, why should I apologize to him?

title: "不要" ile olumsuz emir
summary: "不要" (búyào) bir eylemi yapmamayı söyler: 不要说话！ = Konuşma!
explanation: "不要", birine bir şeyi YAPMAMASINI söyleyen olumsuz emir kalıbıdır: 不要迟到 (geç kalma). Daha kısa/samimi biçimi "别" (bié) ile aynı anlama gelir: 不要走 = 别走 (gitme). "不要" ayrıca "...istemiyorum" anlamında da kullanılabilir (bağlam ayırt eder). Nazikçe rica için başına "请" eklenir: 请不要吸烟 (lütfen sigara içmeyin).

examples.zh: 上课的时候不要说话。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou búyào shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't talk during class.

examples.zh: 你不要担心,一切都会好起来的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào dānxīn, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de.
examples.en: Don't worry, everything will be okay.

examples.zh: 开车的时候请不要看手机。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē de shíhou qǐng búyào kàn shǒujī.
examples.en: Please don't look at your phone while driving.

examples.zh: 这件事不要告诉别人,是个秘密。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì búyào gàosù biérén, shì ge mìmì.
examples.en: Don't tell anyone about this, it's a secret.

examples.zh: 不要浪费时间,快去做作业吧。
examples.pinyin: Búyào làngfèi shíjiān, kuài qù zuò zuòyè ba.
examples.en: Don't waste time, go do your homework.

examples.zh: 你不要生气,听我解释一下。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào shēngqì, tīng wǒ jiěshì yíxià.
examples.en: Don't be angry, let me explain.

examples.zh: 天太黑了,你不要一个人走。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài hēi le, nǐ búyào yí ge rén zǒu.
examples.en: It's too dark, don't walk alone.

examples.zh: 不要因为一次失败就放弃。
examples.pinyin: Búyào yīnwèi yí cì shībài jiù fàngqì.
examples.en: Don't give up just because of one failure.

examples.zh: 你不要总是拿自己跟别人比。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào zǒngshì ná zìjǐ gēn biérén bǐ.
examples.en: Don't always compare yourself to others.

examples.zh: 请大家不要在这里大声说话。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā búyào zài zhèlǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.en: Please don't speak loudly here.

examples.zh: 不要相信那些没有根据的话。
examples.pinyin: Búyào xiāngxìn nàxiē méiyǒu gēnjù de huà.
examples.en: Don't believe those unfounded words.

examples.zh: 你不要把所有的事都放在心上。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào bǎ suǒyǒu de shì dōu fàng zài xīn shàng.
examples.en: Don't take everything to heart.

examples.zh: 东西还没坏,不要着急扔掉。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxi hái méi huài, búyào zháojí rēngdiào.
examples.en: The thing isn't broken yet, don't rush to throw it away.

examples.zh: 不要害怕犯错,错误也是一种学习。
examples.pinyin: Búyào hàipà fàncuò, cuòwù yě shì yì zhǒng xuéxí.
examples.en: Don't be afraid of making mistakes; mistakes are also learning.

examples.zh: 你不要太累了,记得好好休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào tài lèi le, jìde hǎohǎo xiūxi.
examples.en: Don't overtire yourself, remember to rest well.

examples.zh: 不要对陌生人说太多自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Búyào duì mòshēngrén shuō tài duō zìjǐ de shì.
examples.en: Don't tell strangers too much about yourself.

examples.zh: 请不要随便动我桌子上的东西。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng búyào suíbiàn dòng wǒ zhuōzi shàng de dōngxi.
examples.en: Please don't move things on my desk without asking.

examples.zh: 你不要小看这件小事,它很重要。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào xiǎokàn zhè jiàn xiǎoshì, tā hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: Don't underestimate this small matter, it's important.

examples.zh: 不要等到失去了才知道珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Búyào děngdào shīqù le cái zhīdào zhēnxī.
examples.en: Don't wait until you've lost something to cherish it.

examples.zh: 你不要勉强自己去做不喜欢的事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào miǎnqiǎng zìjǐ qù zuò bù xǐhuan de shì.
examples.en: Don't force yourself to do things you dislike.

examples.zh: 不要因为别人的看法而改变自己。
examples.pinyin: Búyào yīnwèi biérén de kànfǎ ér gǎibiàn zìjǐ.
examples.en: Don't change yourself because of others' opinions.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,不要给他太大的压力。
examples.pinyin: Háizi hái xiǎo, búyào gěi tā tài dà de yālì.
examples.en: The child is still young, don't put too much pressure on him.

examples.zh: 你不要一直低头,抬起头来看看这个世界。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào yìzhí dītóu, tái qǐ tóu lái kànkan zhège shìjiè.
examples.en: Don't keep looking down; lift your head and see the world.

examples.zh: 不要为了一点小事伤了和气。
examples.pinyin: Búyào wèile yìdiǎn xiǎoshì shāng le héqi.
examples.en: Don't ruin the friendship over a small thing.

examples.zh: 你不要忘了,不管发生什么,我都会支持你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào wàng le, bùguǎn fāshēng shénme, wǒ dōu huì zhīchí nǐ.
examples.en: Don't forget, no matter what happens, I'll support you.

title: Temel cümle dizilişi
summary: Çince'nin temel cümle dizilişi Türkçe'den farklıdır: Özne + Fiil + Nesne (SVO). 我爱你 = Ben seviyorum seni.
explanation: Çince cümle temeli Özne-Fiil-Nesne (SVO) sırasını izler — İngilizce gibi, Türkçe'den (SOV) farklı. "我爱你" (ben-sev-seni), "他喝水" (o-iç-su). Zaman ve yer belirteçleri genellikle öznenin hemen ardında, fiilden ÖNCE gelir: "我明天在家看书" (ben-yarın-evde-oku-kitap). Bu temel iskelet üzerine tüm diğer yapılar kurulur.

examples.zh: 我爱你,这一辈子都不会变。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ài nǐ, zhè yíbèizi dōu bú huì biàn.
examples.en: I love you, and it won't change my whole life.

examples.zh: 孩子每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
examples.pinyin: Háizi měitiān zǎoshang hē yì bēi niúnǎi.
examples.en: The child drinks a glass of milk every morning.

examples.zh: 老师认真地回答了学生的问题。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènzhēn de huídá le xuésheng de wèntí.
examples.en: The teacher answered the students' questions seriously.

examples.zh: 我昨天在图书馆看了一整天书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài túshūguǎn kàn le yìzhěng tiān shū.
examples.en: I read all day at the library yesterday.

examples.zh: 他用自己的努力改变了命运。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zìjǐ de nǔlì gǎibiàn le mìngyùn.
examples.en: He changed his fate through his own effort.

examples.zh: 妈妈给我做了我最爱吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Māma gěi wǒ zuò le wǒ zuì ài chī de cài.
examples.en: Mom made my favorite dish for me.

examples.zh: 我们明天下午三点开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: We have a meeting at three tomorrow afternoon.

examples.zh: 他每个周末都陪父母吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge zhōumò dōu péi fùmǔ chīfàn.
examples.en: He has dinner with his parents every weekend.

examples.zh: 这个消息让所有人都很吃惊。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu hěn chījīng.
examples.en: This news surprised everyone.

examples.zh: 我在这个城市生活了很多年。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhège chéngshì shēnghuó le hěn duō nián.
examples.en: I've lived in this city for many years.

examples.zh: 学生们安静地听老师讲课。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshengmen ānjìng de tīng lǎoshī jiǎngkè.
examples.en: The students quietly listened to the teacher's lecture.

examples.zh: 他常常帮助有困难的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng bāngzhù yǒu kùnnan de rén.
examples.en: He often helps people in difficulty.

examples.zh: 我们一起度过了很多美好的时光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ dùguò le hěn duō měihǎo de shíguāng.
examples.en: We spent a lot of wonderful time together.

examples.zh: 这本书讲了一个很感人的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng le yí ge hěn gǎnrén de gùshi.
examples.en: This book tells a very touching story.

examples.zh: 父母把最好的东西都留给了孩子。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bǎ zuì hǎo de dōngxi dōu liú gěi le háizi.
examples.en: Parents leave the best things for their children.

examples.zh: 我每天骑自行车去上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān qí zìxíngchē qù shàngbān.
examples.en: I ride a bicycle to work every day.

examples.zh: 她轻轻地关上了房间的门。
examples.pinyin: Tā qīngqīng de guānshàng le fángjiān de mén.
examples.en: She gently closed the door of the room.

examples.zh: 这场大雨影响了很多人的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàyǔ yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén de shēnghuó.
examples.en: This heavy rain affected many people's lives.

examples.zh: 我们应该珍惜现在拥有的一切。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zhēnxī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yíqiè.
examples.en: We should cherish everything we have now.

examples.zh: 他花了三年时间写完了这本书。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián shíjiān xiěwán le zhè běn shū.
examples.en: He spent three years finishing this book.

examples.zh: 孩子们在草地上快乐地玩耍。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng kuàilè de wánshuǎ.
examples.en: The children play happily on the grass.

examples.zh: 这位老人一生都在帮助别人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén yìshēng dōu zài bāngzhù biérén.
examples.en: This old man spent his whole life helping others.

examples.zh: 我用一句话总结了今天的会议。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yòng yí jù huà zǒngjié le jīntiān de huìyì.
examples.en: I summarized today's meeting in one sentence.

examples.zh: 时间会给我们所有问题的答案。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān huì gěi wǒmen suǒyǒu wèntí de dá'àn.
examples.en: Time will give us the answers to all questions.

examples.zh: 他默默地做着自己认为对的事。
examples.pinyin: Tā mòmò de zuòzhe zìjǐ rènwéi duì de shì.
examples.en: He quietly does what he believes is right.

title: "是" ile isimleri bağlama (A 是 B)
summary: "是" (shì) İngilizce'deki "to be" gibi iki ismi eşitler: A 是 B = A, B'dir. 我是学生 = Ben öğrenciyim.
explanation: "是", iki ismi/isim öbeğini birbirine bağlayan bağlaç-fiildir (kimlik/tanım): 他是医生 (o doktordur). ÖNEMLİ: "是" sıfatlarla KULLANILMAZ — "我是高" yanlıştır; sıfat için "很" kullanılır (我很高). "是" sadece "isim + isim" bağlar. Olumsuzu "不是". Vurgu/onay için "是" tek başına "evet/öyle" anlamında da kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我是一名中学老师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì yì míng zhōngxué lǎoshī.
examples.en: I am a middle school teacher.

examples.zh: 这不是我的错,你别怪我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bú shì wǒ de cuò, nǐ bié guài wǒ.
examples.en: This isn't my fault, don't blame me.

examples.zh: 他是我认识的最善良的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ rènshi de zuì shànliáng de rén.
examples.en: He is the kindest person I know.

examples.zh: 这是一个改变很多人命运的决定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge gǎibiàn hěn duō rén mìngyùn de juédìng.
examples.en: This is a decision that changed many people's fates.

examples.zh: 诚实是最重要的品质之一。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshí shì zuì zhòngyào de pǐnzhì zhīyī.
examples.en: Honesty is one of the most important qualities.

examples.zh: 她是这家公司的创始人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zhè jiā gōngsī de chuàngshǐrén.
examples.en: She is the founder of this company.

examples.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年的日子。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒmen jiéhūn shí zhōunián de rìzi.
examples.en: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.

examples.zh: 这本书是老师推荐给我的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì lǎoshī tuījiàn gěi wǒ de.
examples.en: This book was recommended to me by the teacher.

examples.zh: 失败不是终点,而是新的开始。
examples.pinyin: Shībài bú shì zhōngdiǎn, érshì xīn de kāishǐ.
examples.en: Failure is not the end, but a new beginning.

examples.zh: 这些照片都是我小时候拍的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn dōu shì wǒ xiǎoshíhou pāi de.
examples.en: These photos were all taken when I was little.

examples.zh: 他不是不努力,而是方法不对。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú shì bù nǔlì, érshì fāngfǎ bú duì.
examples.en: It's not that he isn't working hard, but that his method is wrong.

examples.zh: 读书是了解世界的一种方式。
examples.pinyin: Dúshū shì liǎojiě shìjiè de yì zhǒng fāngshì.
examples.en: Reading is a way to understand the world.

examples.zh: 这里是我出生和长大的地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì wǒ chūshēng hé zhǎngdà de dìfang.
examples.en: This is where I was born and grew up.

examples.zh: 他们是一对结婚五十年的老夫妻。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì yí duì jiéhūn wǔshí nián de lǎo fūqī.
examples.en: They are an old couple married for fifty years.

examples.zh: 这是我第一次来这么大的城市。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái zhème dà de chéngshì.
examples.en: This is my first time in such a big city.

examples.zh: 健康的身体是一切的基础。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng de shēntǐ shì yíqiè de jīchǔ.
examples.en: A healthy body is the foundation of everything.

examples.zh: 他现在是我们团队里最重要的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiànzài shì wǒmen tuánduì lǐ zuì zhòngyào de rén.
examples.en: He is now the most important person on our team.

examples.zh: 这不是钱的问题,而是原则的问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bú shì qián de wèntí, érshì yuánzé de wèntí.
examples.en: This isn't a matter of money, but of principle.

examples.zh: 她是那种一旦决定就不会回头的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nà zhǒng yídàn juédìng jiù bú huì huítóu de rén.
examples.en: She's the kind of person who won't look back once she decides.

examples.zh: 这首歌是我最喜欢的一首。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de yì shǒu.
examples.en: This song is my favorite.

examples.zh: 努力是通往成功的唯一道路。
examples.pinyin: Nǔlì shì tōngwǎng chénggōng de wéiyī dàolù.
examples.en: Hard work is the only road to success.

examples.zh: 这不是结束,只是一个新阶段的开始。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bú shì jiéshù, zhǐshì yí ge xīn jiēduàn de kāishǐ.
examples.en: This isn't the end, just the start of a new stage.

examples.zh: 他是那个在我最难的时候陪着我的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nàge zài wǒ zuì nán de shíhou péizhe wǒ de rén.
examples.en: He's the one who stayed with me in my hardest times.

examples.zh: 这些困难都是暂时的,一定会过去。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē kùnnan dōu shì zànshí de, yídìng huì guòqù.
examples.en: These difficulties are all temporary and will surely pass.

examples.zh: 对我来说,家人永远是第一位的。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, jiārén yǒngyuǎn shì dì yī wèi de.
examples.en: For me, family always comes first.

title: "太...了" ile "aşırı/çok"
summary: "太...了" (tài...le) bir sıfatın aşırılığını/yoğunluğunu vurgular: 太好了！ = Çok güzel!
explanation: "太" sıfatın önüne, "了" cümle sonuna gelerek "aşırı derecede / çok" anlamı verir: 太贵了 (çok pahalı), 太累了 (çok yorgun). Genellikle bir şeyin fazla olmasından yakınmayı (太吵了 - çok gürültülü) ya da güçlü olumlu/olumsuz duyguyu (太好了 - harika!) ifade eder. "太"'dan sonra "了"'yu unutmamak önemlidir; "了"'suz "太" biraz eksik durur.

examples.zh: 太好了！我们终于成功了！
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒmen zhōngyú chénggōng le!
examples.en: Great! We finally succeeded!

examples.zh: 这件衣服太贵了,我买不起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì le, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
examples.en: This piece of clothing is too expensive, I can't afford it.

examples.zh: 今天太累了,我想早点睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tài lèi le, wǒ xiǎng zǎodiǎn shuìjiào.
examples.en: I'm too tired today, I want to sleep early.

examples.zh: 这里的风景太美了,我都舍不得走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng tài měi le, wǒ dōu shěbùdé zǒu le.
examples.en: The scenery here is so beautiful, I don't want to leave.

examples.zh: 外面太吵了,我根本没法学习。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn tài chǎo le, wǒ gēnběn méifǎ xuéxí.
examples.en: It's too noisy outside, I can't study at all.

examples.zh: 你来得太及时了,我正需要帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de tài jíshí le, wǒ zhèng xūyào bāngmáng.
examples.en: You came just in time, I really need help.

examples.zh: 这个孩子太聪明了,一学就会。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi tài cōngming le, yì xué jiù huì.
examples.en: This child is so smart, he learns instantly.

examples.zh: 最近工作太忙了,我都没时间陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò tài máng le, wǒ dōu méi shíjiān péi jiārén.
examples.en: Work has been too busy lately, I have no time for my family.

examples.zh: 这道菜太咸了,你放了多少盐？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài tài xián le, nǐ fàng le duōshao yán?
examples.en: This dish is too salty, how much salt did you put in?

examples.zh: 能再见到你,我太高兴了。
examples.pinyin: Néng zàijiàndào nǐ, wǒ tài gāoxìng le.
examples.en: I'm so happy to see you again.

examples.zh: 这个消息太让人吃惊了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi tài ràng rén chījīng le.
examples.en: This news is too shocking.

examples.zh: 你对自己太严格了,应该放松一点。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì zìjǐ tài yángé le, yīnggāi fàngsōng yìdiǎn.
examples.en: You're too hard on yourself, you should relax a bit.

examples.zh: 这个地方离我家太远了,来一次不容易。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang lí wǒ jiā tài yuǎn le, lái yí cì bù róngyì.
examples.en: This place is too far from my home, it's not easy to come.

examples.zh: 他做的蛋糕太好吃了,我吃了三块。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de dàngāo tài hǎochī le, wǒ chī le sān kuài.
examples.en: The cake he made is so delicious, I ate three pieces.

examples.zh: 今天的天气太热了,大家都不想出门。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì tài rè le, dàjiā dōu bù xiǎng chūmén.
examples.en: The weather today is too hot, nobody wants to go out.

examples.zh: 这件事太复杂了,一句话说不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tài fùzá le, yí jù huà shuō bu qīngchu.
examples.en: This matter is too complicated to explain in one sentence.

examples.zh: 你实在太客气了,让你破费了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shízài tài kèqi le, ràng nǐ pòfèi le.
examples.en: You're really too polite, you spent too much.

examples.zh: 时间过得太快了,一转眼就是十年。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān guò de tài kuài le, yì zhuǎnyǎn jiùshì shí nián.
examples.en: Time passes too fast, ten years in the blink of an eye.

examples.zh: 这个问题太难了,连老师都答不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài nán le, lián lǎoshī dōu dá bu chūlái.
examples.en: This question is so hard even the teacher can't answer it.

examples.zh: 你这样做太危险了,我不同意。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng zuò tài wēixiǎn le, wǒ bù tóngyì.
examples.en: What you're doing is too dangerous, I don't agree.

examples.zh: 这条裙子太漂亮了,你穿上一定好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi tài piàoliang le, nǐ chuān shàng yídìng hǎokàn.
examples.en: This skirt is so pretty, you'll look great in it.

examples.zh: 能有你这样的朋友,我太幸运了。
examples.pinyin: Néng yǒu nǐ zhèyàng de péngyou, wǒ tài xìngyùn le.
examples.en: I'm so lucky to have a friend like you.

examples.zh: 这本书太厚了,我一个月都看不完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài hòu le, wǒ yí ge yuè dōu kàn bu wán.
examples.en: This book is too thick, I can't finish it in a month.

examples.zh: 你别太伤心了,日子还得往前过。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié tài shāngxīn le, rìzi hái děi wǎng qián guò.
examples.en: Don't be too sad, life still has to go on.

examples.zh: 这个价格太合适了,我们赶紧订吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàgé tài héshì le, wǒmen gǎnjǐn dìng ba.
examples.en: This price is just right, let's book it quickly.

title: Basit "isim + sıfat" cümleleri
summary: Çince'de sıfat yüklem olduğunda "是" kullanılmaz; sıfattan önce genellikle "很" (hěn) gelir: 我很好 = Ben iyiyim.
explanation: Sıfat yüklemli cümlelerde "是" KULLANILMAZ (bu çok yaygın bir hatadır). Bunun yerine sıfat doğrudan yüklem olur ve önüne genellikle "很" konur: 天气很好 (hava güzel). Buradaki "很" her zaman "çok" anlamı taşımaz; çıplak sıfat kıyaslama çağrıştırdığı için dengeleyici bir dolgu görevi görür. Olumsuzda "很" düşer: 天气不好 (hava güzel değil).

examples.zh: 今天天气很好,我们出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.en: The weather is nice today, let's go out for a walk.

examples.zh: 这个房间很干净,也很安静。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān hěn gānjìng, yě hěn ānjìng.
examples.en: This room is very clean and also quiet.

examples.zh: 他人很好,大家都喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Tā rén hěn hǎo, dàjiā dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.en: He is a nice person, everyone likes him.

examples.zh: 这条路不太好走,你小心一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bú tài hǎo zǒu, nǐ xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn.
examples.en: This road is hard to walk, be careful.

examples.zh: 她的声音很好听,像唱歌一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng, xiàng chànggē yíyàng.
examples.en: Her voice is very pleasant, like singing.

examples.zh: 这里的东西很便宜,质量也不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dōngxi hěn piányi, zhìliàng yě búcuò.
examples.en: The things here are cheap and the quality is good too.

examples.zh: 我最近很忙,几乎没有休息的时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn hěn máng, jīhū méiyǒu xiūxi de shíjiān.
examples.en: I've been very busy lately, with almost no time to rest.

examples.zh: 这个孩子很懂事,从来不让父母操心。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi hěn dǒngshì, cónglái bú ràng fùmǔ cāoxīn.
examples.en: This child is very sensible and never worries his parents.

examples.zh: 山上的空气很新鲜,让人心情很好。
examples.pinyin: Shān shàng de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān, ràng rén xīnqíng hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The air on the mountain is fresh, it puts you in a good mood.

examples.zh: 这道题很简单,你再看一遍就会了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí hěn jiǎndān, nǐ zài kàn yí biàn jiù huì le.
examples.en: This question is simple, you'll get it after another look.

examples.zh: 他做事很认真,从不马虎。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn rènzhēn, cóng bù mǎhu.
examples.en: He works very carefully, never carelessly.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆的服务很好,菜也很新鲜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de fúwù hěn hǎo, cài yě hěn xīnxiān.
examples.en: This restaurant's service is good and the food is fresh.

examples.zh: 她的心地很善良,总是帮助别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xīndì hěn shànliáng, zǒngshì bāngzhù biérén.
examples.en: She is kind-hearted and always helps others.

examples.zh: 今年冬天特别冷,你要多穿点。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián dōngtiān tèbié lěng, nǐ yào duō chuān diǎn.
examples.en: This winter is especially cold, wear more clothes.

examples.zh: 这本书很有意思,我一个晚上就看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yí ge wǎnshang jiù kànwán le.
examples.en: This book is interesting, I finished it in one evening.

examples.zh: 他的想法很成熟,不像二十岁的年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ hěn chéngshú, bú xiàng èrshí suì de niánqīngrén.
examples.en: His thinking is mature, unlike a twenty-year-old.

examples.zh: 这个城市的夜晚很热闹。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de yèwǎn hěn rènao.
examples.en: The nights in this city are lively.

examples.zh: 她的房间不大,可是收拾得很温馨。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān bú dà, kěshì shōushi de hěn wēnxīn.
examples.en: Her room isn't big, but it's cozy and tidy.

examples.zh: 这里的人很热情,让我感觉像在家一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén hěn rèqíng, ràng wǒ gǎnjué xiàng zài jiā yíyàng.
examples.en: The people here are warm, making me feel at home.

examples.zh: 他的中文很流利,几乎听不出口音。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén hěn liúlì, jīhū tīng bu chū kǒuyīn.
examples.en: His Chinese is fluent, you can hardly hear an accent.

examples.zh: 这个决定很难,可是我必须做。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng hěn nán, kěshì wǒ bìxū zuò.
examples.en: This decision is hard, but I have to make it.

examples.zh: 今天的月亮很圆,也很亮。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de yuèliang hěn yuán, yě hěn liàng.
examples.en: The moon is round and bright tonight.

examples.zh: 他对工作很有热情,每天都很努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōngzuò hěn yǒu rèqíng, měitiān dōu hěn nǔlì.
examples.en: He's passionate about his work and works hard every day.

examples.zh: 这段时间我过得很充实。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí.
examples.en: I've been living a very fulfilling life lately.

examples.zh: 她笑起来的样子很好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiào qǐlái de yàngzi hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: She looks lovely when she smiles.

title: Olumlu-olumsuz soru (Fiil 不 Fiil)
pattern: Fiil + 不 + Fiil ? / Sıfat + 不 + Sıfat ?
summary: Fiil veya sıfatın olumlu ve olumsuz biçimini yan yana koyarak soru sorulur: 你去不去？ = Gidiyor musun?
explanation: "吗" kullanmadan soru sormanın bir yolu, yüklemin olumlu + olumsuz biçimini art arda söylemektir: 好不好? (iyi mi?), 是不是? (öyle mi?), 去不去? (gidiyor mu?). Cevap, olumlu ya da olumsuz biçimden biriyle verilir. Bu yapıda cümle sonuna "吗" EKLENMEZ (ikisi birlikte kullanılmaz). Çok heceli fiillerde genellikle ilk hece tekrarlanır: 喜不喜欢?

examples.zh: 你明天来不来我的生日聚会？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān lái bu lái wǒ de shēngri jùhuì?
examples.en: Are you coming to my birthday party tomorrow?

examples.zh: 这道菜辣不辣？我不太能吃辣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài là bu là? Wǒ bú tài néng chī là.
examples.en: Is this dish spicy? I can't handle spicy food well.

examples.zh: 你喜不喜欢这个礼物？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ bu xǐhuan zhège lǐwù?
examples.en: Do you like this gift?

examples.zh: 这件衣服你觉得合不合适？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ juéde hé bu héshì?
examples.en: Do you think this outfit suits me?

examples.zh: 他到底是不是真的想帮我们？
examples.pinyin: Tā dàodǐ shì bu shì zhēn de xiǎng bāng wǒmen?
examples.en: Does he really want to help us or not?

examples.zh: 你知不知道现在几点了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhī bu zhīdào xiànzài jǐ diǎn le?
examples.en: Do you know what time it is now?

examples.zh: 这个周末你有没有空？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu méiyǒu kòng?
examples.en: Are you free this weekend?

examples.zh: 你饿不饿？我给你做点吃的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ è bu è? Wǒ gěi nǐ zuò diǎn chī de.
examples.en: Are you hungry? I'll make you something to eat.

examples.zh: 你听得懂听不懂他说的话？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng de dǒng tīng bu dǒng tā shuō de huà?
examples.en: Can you understand what he's saying or not?

examples.zh: 这件事你想清楚了没有？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ xiǎng qīngchu le méiyǒu?
examples.en: Have you thought this through or not?

examples.zh: 你们公司招不招人？我想应聘。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen gōngsī zhāo bu zhāo rén? Wǒ xiǎng yìngpìn.
examples.en: Is your company hiring? I'd like to apply.

examples.zh: 这个价钱贵不贵？我想再比较一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàqián guì bu guì? Wǒ xiǎng zài bǐjiào yíxià.
examples.en: Is this price expensive? I want to compare a bit more.

examples.zh: 你后不后悔当初的决定？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hòu bu hòuhuǐ dāngchū de juédìng?
examples.en: Do you regret your earlier decision?

examples.zh: 我们是不是应该早点出发？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì bu shì yīnggāi zǎodiǎn chūfā?
examples.en: Shouldn't we set off a little earlier?

examples.zh: 这条路通不通往山顶？
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù tōng bu tōngwǎng shāndǐng?
examples.en: Does this road lead to the mountaintop?

examples.zh: 你相不相信一见钟情？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiāng bu xiāngxìn yíjiànzhōngqíng?
examples.en: Do you believe in love at first sight?

examples.zh: 这么晚了,你饿了没有？
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, nǐ è le méiyǒu?
examples.en: It's so late, are you hungry yet?

examples.zh: 你确不确定这是正确的答案？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ què bu quèdìng zhè shì zhèngquè de dá'àn?
examples.en: Are you sure this is the correct answer?

examples.zh: 孩子睡着了没有？我们小声点。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shuìzháo le méiyǒu? Wǒmen xiǎoshēng diǎn.
examples.en: Has the child fallen asleep? Let's be quiet.

examples.zh: 你觉得这个计划靠不靠谱？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhège jìhuà kào bu kàopǔ?
examples.en: Do you think this plan is reliable?

examples.zh: 这些年你过得好不好？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián nǐ guò de hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Have you been doing well these years?

examples.zh: 你敢不敢一个人去那个地方？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gǎn bu gǎn yí ge rén qù nàge dìfang?
examples.en: Do you dare go to that place alone?

examples.zh: 这件事你同不同意,给个准话。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ tóng bu tóngyì, gěi ge zhǔnhuà.
examples.en: Do you agree with this or not? Give me a clear answer.

examples.zh: 你还记不记得我们第一次见面的地方？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái jì bu jìde wǒmen dì yī cì jiànmiàn de dìfang?
examples.en: Do you still remember where we first met?

examples.zh: 这个东西到底能不能用？
examples.pinyin: Zhège dōngxi dàodǐ néng bu néng yòng?
examples.en: Can this thing actually be used or not?

title: Soru kelimelerinin yeri
pattern: 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿 / 为什么 / 怎么 (yerinde kalır)
summary: Çince'de soru kelimeleri cümle başına taşınmaz; cevabın geleceği yerde durur. 你是谁？ = Sen kimsin? (谁 sonda).
explanation: Çince'nin en önemli soru kuralı: soru kelimeleri (什么 ne, 谁 kim, 哪儿 nerede, 为什么 neden, 怎么 nasıl, 几/多少 kaç) İngilizce/Türkçe'deki gibi cümle başına GİTMEZ. Cümlenin normal sırasını koruyup, cevabın geleceği yere soru kelimesini koyarsınız: "你吃什么?" (ne yiyorsun? — 什么 nesnenin yerinde). Bu tür sorulara "吗" EKLENMEZ.

examples.zh: 你今天晚上想吃什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān wǎnshang xiǎng chī shénme?
examples.en: What do you want to eat tonight?

examples.zh: 刚才给你打电话的那个人是谁？
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà de nàge rén shì shéi?
examples.en: Who was that person who just called you?

examples.zh: 这个周末你打算去哪儿？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎr?
examples.en: Where do you plan to go this weekend?

examples.zh: 你为什么这么晚才回来？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zhème wǎn cái huílái?
examples.en: Why did you come back so late?

examples.zh: 这道题应该怎么做,你能教我吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yīnggāi zěnme zuò, nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.en: How should this problem be done? Can you teach me?

examples.zh: 你们班一共有多少个学生？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen bān yígòng yǒu duōshao ge xuésheng?
examples.en: How many students are there in your class in total?

examples.zh: 这件事你是从哪儿听说的？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ shì cóng nǎr tīngshuō de?
examples.en: Where did you hear about this?

examples.zh: 你觉得这三个方案中哪个最好？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè sān ge fāng'àn zhōng nǎge zuì hǎo?
examples.en: Which of these three plans do you think is best?

examples.zh: 你的生日是几月几号？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shēngri shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
examples.en: What's the date of your birthday?

examples.zh: 你昨天跟谁一起去看电影了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān gēn shéi yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng le?
examples.en: Who did you go to the movies with yesterday?

examples.zh: 你打算在这个城市住多久？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zài zhège chéngshì zhù duōjiǔ?
examples.en: How long do you plan to live in this city?

examples.zh: 这些钱你到底想用来做什么？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē qián nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng yòng lái zuò shénme?
examples.en: What exactly do you want to use this money for?

examples.zh: 你最喜欢的作家是谁？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan de zuòjiā shì shéi?
examples.en: Who is your favorite writer?

examples.zh: 我们应该什么时候出发才不会迟到？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi shénme shíhou chūfā cái bú huì chídào?
examples.en: When should we leave so we won't be late?

examples.zh: 你为什么突然对这件事这么感兴趣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme tūrán duì zhè jiàn shì zhème gǎn xìngqù?
examples.en: Why are you suddenly so interested in this?

examples.zh: 这么多东西,你打算怎么带回去？
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō dōngxi, nǐ dǎsuàn zěnme dài huíqù?
examples.en: So many things, how do you plan to take them back?

examples.zh: 你觉得我们的问题出在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde wǒmen de wèntí chū zài nǎr?
examples.en: Where do you think our problem lies?

examples.zh: 这件事你想让谁来负责？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ xiǎng ràng shéi lái fùzé?
examples.en: Who do you want to be in charge of this?

examples.zh: 你到底想要什么样的生活？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng yào shénmeyàng de shēnghuó?
examples.en: What kind of life do you actually want?

examples.zh: 你知道他为什么不高兴吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā wèishénme bù gāoxìng ma?
examples.en: Do you know why he's unhappy?

examples.zh: 我们下一步应该怎么走？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià yí bù yīnggāi zěnme zǒu?
examples.en: What should our next step be?

examples.zh: 你把我的钥匙放在哪儿了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ wǒ de yàoshi fàng zài nǎr le?
examples.en: Where did you put my keys?

examples.zh: 这么重要的会议,谁没来？
examples.pinyin: Zhème zhòngyào de huìyì, shéi méi lái?
examples.en: Such an important meeting, who didn't come?

examples.zh: 你觉得幸福对你来说是什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde xìngfú duì nǐ lái shuō shì shénme?
examples.en: What do you think happiness means to you?

examples.zh: 我不明白你到底想说什么。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù míngbai nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng shuō shénme.
examples.en: I don't understand what you're trying to say.

title: "...是不是" ile ekli soru
pattern: Cümle + 是不是 / 对不对 / 好不好 ?
summary: Cümle sonuna "是不是 / 对不对 / 好不好" eklenerek onay/rica sorusu yapılır: "...değil mi? / ...olur mu?"
explanation: Bir cümlenin sonuna eklenen "是不是" (öyle değil mi?), "对不对" (doğru değil mi?), "好不好" (olur mu?) gibi kalıplar, Türkçe'deki "...değil mi?" ek sorusuna karşılık gelir. "是不是"/"对不对" bir tahmini onaylatır, "好不好" ise nazikçe öneri/rica yapar: "我们走吧,好不好?" (gidelim, olur mu?). Bu kalıp cümlenin başına da gelebilir (是不是) ama en yaygını sonda kullanmaktır.

examples.zh: 你明天来,是不是？我等你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān lái, shì bu shì? Wǒ děng nǐ.
examples.en: You're coming tomorrow, right? I'll wait for you.

examples.zh: 我们六点出发,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liù diǎn chūfā, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Let's leave at six, okay?

examples.zh: 这样做是对的,对不对？
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò shì duì de, duì bu duì?
examples.en: Doing it this way is right, isn't it?

examples.zh: 你最近是不是遇到什么麻烦了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn shì bu shì yùdào shénme máfan le?
examples.en: Have you run into some trouble lately?

examples.zh: 我们今天就先到这里,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān jiù xiān dào zhèlǐ, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Let's stop here for today, shall we?

examples.zh: 这道菜是你做的,对不对？真好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì nǐ zuò de, duì bu duì? Zhēn hǎochī.
examples.en: You made this dish, didn't you? It's delicious.

examples.zh: 你是不是有话想对我说？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì yǒu huà xiǎng duì wǒ shuō?
examples.en: Is there something you want to tell me?

examples.zh: 我们各让一步,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gè ràng yí bù, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Let's each take a step back, all right?

examples.zh: 你是不是觉得我说得不对？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì juéde wǒ shuō de bú duì?
examples.en: Do you think what I said is wrong?

examples.zh: 这个答案是错的,对不对？
examples.pinyin: Zhège dá'àn shì cuò de, duì bu duì?
examples.en: This answer is wrong, isn't it?

examples.zh: 你今天脸色不太好,是不是没睡好？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān liǎnsè bú tài hǎo, shì bu shì méi shuì hǎo?
examples.en: You don't look well today, didn't you sleep well?

examples.zh: 以后你多陪陪孩子,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Yǐhòu nǐ duō péipei háizi, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: From now on, spend more time with the kids, okay?

examples.zh: 这件事是他先动手的,对不对？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì tā xiān dòngshǒu de, duì bu duì?
examples.en: He started it first, didn't he?

examples.zh: 你是不是把我忘了？这么久都不联系。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì bǎ wǒ wàng le? Zhème jiǔ dōu bù liánxì.
examples.en: Did you forget about me? You haven't been in touch for so long.

examples.zh: 我们把音乐关小一点,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ yīnyuè guān xiǎo yìdiǎn, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Let's turn the music down a bit, shall we?

examples.zh: 你是不是也这么觉得？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì yě zhème juéde?
examples.en: Don't you feel the same way?

examples.zh: 这个决定你已经想好了,是不是？
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng nǐ yǐjīng xiǎnghǎo le, shì bu shì?
examples.en: You've already decided on this, haven't you?

examples.zh: 从明天开始我们都早点起床,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān kāishǐ wǒmen dōu zǎodiǎn qǐchuáng, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Starting tomorrow, let's all get up early, okay?

examples.zh: 你是不是还在生我的气？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì hái zài shēng wǒ de qì?
examples.en: Are you still angry with me?

examples.zh: 这次真的是我错了,对不对？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zhēn de shì wǒ cuò le, duì bu duì?
examples.en: This time it really was my fault, wasn't it?

examples.zh: 我们一起把这件事做完,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuòwán, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Let's finish this together, shall we?

examples.zh: 你是不是有什么事瞒着我？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì yǒu shénme shì mánzhe wǒ?
examples.en: Are you hiding something from me?

examples.zh: 孩子的教育最重要,对不对？
examples.pinyin: Háizi de jiàoyù zuì zhòngyào, duì bu duì?
examples.en: A child's education matters most, doesn't it?

examples.zh: 下次你提前告诉我一声,好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xià cì nǐ tíqián gàosù wǒ yì shēng, hǎo bu hǎo?
examples.en: Next time let me know in advance, okay?

examples.zh: 你是不是一直都知道真相？

title: "...吗" ile ekli soru (是吗/对吗/好吗)
pattern: Cümle + 是吗 / 对吗 / 好吗 ?
summary: Cümle sonuna "是吗/对吗/好吗" eklenerek daha yumuşak bir onay/rica sorusu yapılır: "...öyle mi? / ...olur mu?"
explanation: "是不是/对不对/好不好" ile aynı işlevi görür ama "吗"'lı biçim biraz daha yumuşak ve daha az ısrarcıdır. "对吗?" (doğru mu?), "好吗?" (olur mu?), "是吗?" (öyle mi? / sahi mi?). Özellikle "是吗?" tek başına söylenince "Öyle mi? / Gerçekten mi?" şeklinde hafif şaşkınlık/ilgi bildirir. Bu kalıplar cümleye nazik bir onay arayışı katar.

title: "吗" ile evet-hayır sorusu
summary: Düz bir cümlenin sonuna "吗" (ma) eklenerek evet-hayır sorusu yapılır: 他是老师吗？ = O öğretmen mi?
explanation: Soru sormanın en basit yolu: normal bir bildirim cümlesi kurup sonuna "吗" eklemek. Cümlenin sırası HİÇ değişmez: 你喜欢中国菜 (Çin yemeğini seversin) → 你喜欢中国菜吗? (Çin yemeğini sever misin?). Cevap olumluysa yüklem tekrarlanır (喜欢), olumsuzsa 不/没 eklenir. DİKKAT: "吗", zaten soru kelimesi (什么/谁...) ya da "是不是" içeren cümlelerle KULLANILMAZ.

examples.en: Is this seat taken?

examples.zh: 你能听懂我说的话吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng tīngdǒng wǒ shuō de huà ma?
examples.en: Can you understand what I'm saying?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ qùguò Zhōngguó ma? Nàlǐ zěnmeyàng?

title: "二" ile "两" farkı
summary: İkisi de "iki" demektir ama "二" (èr) sayarken/rakamlarda, "两" (liǎng) ölçü sözcüğünden önce (nesne sayarken) kullanılır.
explanation: Çince'de "iki" için iki kelime vardır. "二" (èr): sayı sayarken, rakamlarda, sıra sayılarında ve on/yüz gibi birimlerde kullanılır (二十 yirmi, 第二 ikinci, 二〇二三). "两" (liǎng): bir ölçü sözcüğünden önce, yani nesne sayarken kullanılır (两个人 iki kişi, 两杯水 iki bardak su). Yani "iki kitap" = 两本书 (二本书 değil), ama "12" = 十二 (十两 değil).

examples.en: I'd like two cups of coffee and a piece of cake.

examples.pinyin: Èr jiā èr děngyú sì.

title: "...死了" ile aşırılık (olumsuz sıfatlar)
summary: "死了" (sǐ le) bir sıfattan sonra gelerek "ölesiye / aşırı derecede" anlamı katar: 累死了 = Ölesiye yorgunum.
explanation: "死了" (kelime anlamı "öldü") bir sıfatın hemen ardına gelerek abartılı bir yoğunluk verir — Türkçe'deki "ölesiye/çok fena" gibi. Genellikle olumsuz/rahatsız edici durumlar için kullanılır: 饿死了 (çok açım), 热死了 (sıcaktan öldüm), 烦死了 (çok sıkıldım). Konuşma dilinde çok yaygındır ve abartılı, samimi bir tondadır. "太...了"'dan daha güçlü ve daha gündelik durur.

examples.zh: 我从早上到现在什么都没吃,饿死了。

examples.en: I haven't eaten anything since morning, I'm starving.
