examples.en: Being home alone is so boring, come back soon.

examples.zh: 这次考试没考好,我后悔死了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo, wǒ hòuhuǐ sǐ le.
examples.en: I didn't do well on this exam, I regret it so much.

examples.zh: 这么晚了还找不到你,我担心死了。
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le hái zhǎo bu dào nǐ, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.en: It's so late and I still couldn't find you, I was worried sick.

examples.zh: 她今天穿得美死了,大家都在看她。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān chuān de měi sǐ le, dàjiā dōu zài kàn tā.
examples.en: She's dressed stunningly today, everyone is looking at her.

examples.zh: 这个星期天天加班,我快忙死了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī tiāntiān jiābān, wǒ kuài máng sǐ le.
examples.en: I've worked overtime every day this week, I'm swamped.

examples.zh: 排了这么长的队,我烦死了。
examples.pinyin: Pái le zhème cháng de duì, wǒ fán sǐ le.
examples.en: After queuing in such a long line, I'm so annoyed.

examples.zh: 这碗面辣死了,我一直在喝水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wǎn miàn là sǐ le, wǒ yìzhí zài hē shuǐ.
examples.en: This bowl of noodles is deadly spicy, I keep drinking water.

examples.zh: 好久没见到你了,我想你想死了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎojiǔ méi jiàndào nǐ le, wǒ xiǎng nǐ xiǎng sǐ le.
examples.en: I haven't seen you in ages, I've missed you terribly.

examples.zh: 这双鞋挤死了,穿一天脚就疼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié jǐ sǐ le, chuān yì tiān jiǎo jiù téng.
examples.en: These shoes are painfully tight; after a day my feet hurt.

examples.zh: 孩子考上了大学,我们高兴死了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi kǎoshàng le dàxué, wǒmen gāoxìng sǐ le.
examples.en: The child got into university, we're overjoyed.

examples.zh: 这个电梯坏了一个星期,不方便死了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diàntī huài le yí ge xīngqī, bù fāngbiàn sǐ le.
examples.en: This elevator has been broken for a week, it's terribly inconvenient.

examples.zh: 听到这个坏消息,我难过死了。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège huài xiāoxi, wǒ nánguò sǐ le.
examples.en: Hearing this bad news, I'm devastated.

examples.zh: 这个房间小死了,连一张床都放不下。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān xiǎo sǐ le, lián yì zhāng chuáng dōu fàng bu xià.
examples.en: This room is tiny, it can't even fit a bed.

title: "差不多" ile yaklaşıklık
summary: "差不多" (chàbuduō) "neredeyse, aşağı yukarı, hemen hemen" anlamı verir: 我们差不多到了 = Neredeyse vardık.
explanation: "差不多" (kelime kelime "fark çok değil") bir şeyin yaklaşık/neredeyse olduğunu belirtir. Zarf olarak fiil/sıfattan önce: 差不多一样 (hemen hemen aynı), 差不多好了 (neredeyse bitti). Sayılarla: 差不多五十岁 (aşağı yukarı elli yaş). Ayrıca tek başına "idare eder, fena değil" anlamında da kullanılabilir. Çince'de çok yaygın, esnek bir ifadedir.

examples.zh: 我们差不多到了,再有五分钟就下车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chàbuduō dào le, zài yǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù xiàchē.
examples.en: We're almost there, we'll get off in five more minutes.

examples.zh: 这两个包差不多一样,你随便拿一个。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge bāo chàbuduō yíyàng, nǐ suíbiàn ná yí ge.
examples.en: These two bags are about the same, just take either one.

examples.zh: 他跟我差不多高,可能比我高一点点。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ chàbuduō gāo, kěnéng bǐ wǒ gāo yìdiǎndiǎn.
examples.en: He's about my height, maybe just a bit taller.

examples.zh: 饭差不多做好了,你们先坐一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Fàn chàbuduō zuòhǎo le, nǐmen xiān zuò yíhuìr.
examples.en: The food is almost ready, please sit for a bit.

examples.zh: 这件事差不多解决了,你别担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì chàbuduō jiějué le, nǐ bié dānxīn.
examples.en: This matter is nearly resolved, don't worry.

examples.zh: 我在这家公司差不多工作了十年。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè jiā gōngsī chàbuduō gōngzuò le shí nián.
examples.en: I've worked at this company for about ten years.

examples.zh: 我们的想法差不多,应该能合作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ chàbuduō, yīnggāi néng hézuò.
examples.en: Our ideas are similar, we should be able to work together.

examples.zh: 时间差不多了,我们该出发了。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān chàbuduō le, wǒmen gāi chūfā le.
examples.en: It's about time, we should set off.

examples.zh: 这两种颜色差不多,一般人看不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng yánsè chàbuduō, yìbān rén kàn bu chūlái.
examples.en: These two colors are nearly the same, most people can't tell.

examples.zh: 他每个月差不多能挣一万块。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge yuè chàbuduō néng zhèng yíwàn kuài.
examples.en: He can earn about ten thousand yuan a month.

examples.zh: 我的中文水平和他差不多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng hé tā chàbuduō.
examples.en: My Chinese level is about the same as his.

examples.zh: 这本书我差不多看完了,只剩最后一章。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ chàbuduō kànwán le, zhǐ shèng zuìhòu yì zhāng.
examples.en: I've almost finished this book, only the last chapter left.

examples.zh: 从我家到公司差不多要一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōngsī chàbuduō yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: It takes about an hour from my home to the office.

examples.zh: 这个大小差不多,应该合适。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàxiǎo chàbuduō, yīnggāi héshì.
examples.en: This size is about right, it should fit.

examples.zh: 钱差不多花完了,我们该省着点了。
examples.pinyin: Qián chàbuduō huāwán le, wǒmen gāi shěngzhe diǎn le.
examples.en: The money is almost gone, we should start saving.

examples.zh: 大家的意见差不多,那就这么决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de yìjiàn chàbuduō, nà jiù zhème juédìng ba.
examples.en: Everyone's opinion is about the same, so let's decide this way.

examples.zh: 我们俩的性格差不多,所以很聊得来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ de xìnggé chàbuduō, suǒyǐ hěn liáodelái.
examples.en: Our personalities are similar, so we get along well.

examples.zh: 这些水果差不多都熟了,可以吃了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ chàbuduō dōu shú le, kěyǐ chī le.
examples.en: These fruits are nearly all ripe, you can eat them.

examples.zh: 他说的和你说的差不多,没什么区别。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de hé nǐ shuō de chàbuduō, méi shénme qūbié.
examples.en: What he said is about the same as yours, no real difference.

examples.zh: 我准备得差不多了,明天就可以出发。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǔnbèi de chàbuduō le, míngtiān jiù kěyǐ chūfā.
examples.en: I'm almost done preparing, I can leave tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这两家饭馆的味道差不多,价钱也差不多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā fànguǎn de wèidào chàbuduō, jiàqián yě chàbuduō.
examples.en: These two restaurants taste about the same, and cost about the same.

examples.zh: 他们年纪差不多,应该很有共同话题。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen niánjì chàbuduō, yīnggāi hěn yǒu gòngtóng huàtí.
examples.en: They're about the same age, they should have a lot in common.

examples.zh: 这个项目差不多完成了百分之八十。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù chàbuduō wánchéng le bǎi fēn zhī bāshí.
examples.en: This project is about eighty percent complete.

examples.zh: 我等了差不多一个小时,他才终于出现。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le chàbuduō yí ge xiǎoshí, tā cái zhōngyú chūxiàn.
examples.en: I waited about an hour before he finally showed up.

examples.zh: 天差不多黑了,我们赶快回家吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān chàbuduō hēi le, wǒmen gǎnkuài huíjiā ba.
examples.en: It's nearly dark, let's hurry home.

title: "都" ile miktar vurgusu
pattern: 大家 / 很多人 + 都⋯⋯
summary: "都" (dōu) çoğul/geniş bir özneden sonra gelerek "herkes, çoğu" vurgusu yapar: 大家都知道 = Herkes biliyor.
explanation: "都", geniş kapsamlı bir özneyle (大家 herkes, 很多人 birçok kişi, 所有人 herkes) kullanıldığında miktar/kapsam vurgusu yapar. Kural yine aynı: "都" öznenin ardından, fiilden önce gelir. "很多人都喜欢" (birçok insan sever) — buradaki "都", çokluğu pekiştirir. "每" (her), "任何" (herhangi) gibi ifadelerle de neredeyse zorunlu olarak "都" birlikte kullanılır.

examples.zh: 这件事大家都知道了,你不用瞒着。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu zhīdào le, nǐ búyòng mánzhe.
examples.en: Everyone already knows about this, you don't need to hide it.

examples.zh: 很多人都觉得他是个天才。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu juéde tā shì ge tiāncái.
examples.en: Many people think he's a genius.

examples.zh: 所有的门都锁上了,进不去。
examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu de mén dōu suǒshàng le, jìn bu qù.
examples.en: All the doors are locked, we can't get in.

examples.zh: 这里的每个人都很热情。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi ge rén dōu hěn rèqíng.
examples.en: Everyone here is very warm.

examples.zh: 这些菜大家都很喜欢,一下子就吃完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuan, yíxiàzi jiù chīwán le.
examples.en: Everyone loved these dishes, they were gone in no time.

examples.zh: 很多年轻人都想去大城市工作。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīngrén dōu xiǎng qù dà chéngshì gōngzuò.
examples.en: Many young people want to work in big cities.

examples.zh: 我问了很多人,大家都不知道答案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèn le hěn duō rén, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào dá'àn.
examples.en: I asked many people, and none of them knew the answer.

examples.zh: 每个来过这里的人都想再来一次。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge láiguò zhèlǐ de rén dōu xiǎng zài lái yí cì.
examples.en: Everyone who's been here wants to come again.

examples.zh: 任何人都有可能犯这样的错误。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yǒu kěnéng fàn zhèyàng de cuòwù.
examples.en: Anyone could make this kind of mistake.

examples.zh: 很多同事都对新经理很满意。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō tóngshì dōu duì xīn jīnglǐ hěn mǎnyì.
examples.en: Many colleagues are satisfied with the new manager.

examples.zh: 这个道理其实很多人都懂,可是做不到。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàolǐ qíshí hěn duō rén dōu dǒng, kěshì zuò bu dào.
examples.en: Many people actually understand this, but can't do it.

examples.zh: 这次活动来的每个人都收到了礼物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng lái de měi ge rén dōu shōudào le lǐwù.
examples.en: Everyone who came to this event received a gift.

examples.zh: 很多父母都希望孩子将来能过得好。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō fùmǔ dōu xīwàng háizi jiānglái néng guò de hǎo.
examples.en: Many parents hope their children will live well in the future.

examples.zh: 这首歌很多人都会唱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē hěn duō rén dōu huì chàng.
examples.en: Many people can sing this song.

examples.zh: 这里的东西每样都很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dōngxi měi yàng dōu hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.en: Everything here is very distinctive.

examples.zh: 很多游客都是听说了它的名气才来的。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō yóukè dōu shì tīngshuō le tā de míngqi cái lái de.
examples.en: Many tourists come having heard of its fame.

examples.zh: 这个决定影响了很多人,大家都很关心。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng yǐngxiǎng le hěn duō rén, dàjiā dōu hěn guānxīn.
examples.en: This decision affected many people, and everyone cares.

examples.zh: 每一次机会我都不想错过。
examples.pinyin: Měi yí cì jīhuì wǒ dōu bù xiǎng cuòguò.
examples.en: I don't want to miss any opportunity.

examples.zh: 很多学生都参加了这次比赛。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō xuésheng dōu cānjiā le zhè cì bǐsài.
examples.en: Many students took part in this competition.

examples.zh: 这里的每一条街道我都走过。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yì tiáo jiēdào wǒ dōu zǒuguò.
examples.en: I've walked every street here.

examples.zh: 大家都在努力,你也不能落后。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài nǔlì, nǐ yě bù néng luòhòu.
examples.en: Everyone is working hard, you can't fall behind either.

examples.zh: 很多事情都需要时间才能看清楚。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō shìqing dōu xūyào shíjiān cái néng kàn qīngchu.
examples.en: Many things can only be seen clearly with time.

examples.zh: 这本书每一页我都仔细读过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū měi yí yè wǒ dōu zǐxì dúguò.
examples.en: I've carefully read every page of this book.

examples.zh: 很多人都想成功,却不愿意付出努力。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu xiǎng chénggōng, què bú yuànyì fùchū nǔlì.
examples.en: Many people want to succeed but aren't willing to put in the effort.

examples.zh: 这里的每个角落都藏着回忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi ge jiǎoluò dōu cángzhe huíyì.
examples.en: Every corner here holds a memory.

title: "一直" ile "sürekli / hep"
summary: "一直" (yìzhí) bir eylemin/durumun kesintisiz sürdüğünü anlatır: 我一直在等你 = Hep seni bekliyordum.
explanation: "一直" bir eylemin başından sonuna DEĞİŞMEDEN, kesintisiz sürdüğünü belirtir — hem zaman içinde süreklilik (我一直住在这里 - hep burada yaşadım) hem de bir doğrultuda devam (一直往前走 - hep düz git). Özneden sonra, fiilden önce gelir. "总是" (zǒngshì, her zaman/genellikle) tekrarlanan durumu, "一直" ise kesintisiz süreni vurgular.

examples.zh: 我一直在等你的消息,你怎么不回我？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zài děng nǐ de xiāoxi, nǐ zěnme bù huí wǒ?
examples.en: I've been waiting for your message all along, why don't you reply?

examples.zh: 他从小到大一直很努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo dào dà yìzhí hěn nǔlì.
examples.en: He's worked hard all his life.

examples.zh: 你一直往前走,到路口就能看到那家店。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dào lùkǒu jiù néng kàndào nà jiā diàn.
examples.en: Keep going straight, you'll see the shop at the intersection.

examples.zh: 这些年我一直住在同一个地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián wǒ yìzhí zhù zài tóng yí ge dìfang.
examples.en: I've lived in the same place all these years.

examples.zh: 她一直想学画画,可是没有时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí xiǎng xué huàhuà, kěshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.en: She's always wanted to learn painting, but has no time.

examples.zh: 这个问题一直困扰着我。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yìzhí kùnrǎozhe wǒ.
examples.en: This problem has been bothering me all along.

examples.zh: 我一直相信,好人会有好报。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiāngxìn, hǎorén huì yǒu hǎobào.
examples.en: I've always believed good people are rewarded.

examples.zh: 他一直没有放弃自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.en: He has never given up on his dream.

examples.zh: 雨一直下,从早上到现在都没停。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yìzhí xià, cóng zǎoshang dào xiànzài dōu méi tíng.
examples.en: It's been raining nonstop from morning until now.

examples.zh: 谢谢你这些年一直支持我。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ zhèxiē nián yìzhí zhīchí wǒ.
examples.en: Thank you for supporting me all these years.

examples.zh: 我一直以为你已经忘了这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí yǐwéi nǐ yǐjīng wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: I'd always assumed you'd forgotten about this.

examples.zh: 他的病一直没好,让家人很担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bìng yìzhí méi hǎo, ràng jiārén hěn dānxīn.
examples.en: His illness never got better, worrying his family.

examples.zh: 我们一直是好朋友,从来没吵过架。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìzhí shì hǎo péngyou, cónglái méi chǎoguò jià.
examples.en: We've always been good friends and never argued.

examples.zh: 她一直低着头,不敢看老师的眼睛。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí dīzhe tóu, bù gǎn kàn lǎoshī de yǎnjing.
examples.en: She kept her head down, not daring to look the teacher in the eye.

examples.zh: 这个愿望我一直藏在心里。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuànwàng wǒ yìzhí cáng zài xīnlǐ.
examples.en: I've always kept this wish in my heart.

examples.zh: 他一直在国外工作,很少回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài guówài gōngzuò, hěn shǎo huíjiā.
examples.en: He's been working abroad and rarely comes home.

examples.zh: 我一直想找机会好好谢谢你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng zhǎo jīhuì hǎohǎo xièxie nǐ.
examples.en: I've always wanted to find a chance to properly thank you.

examples.zh: 这条路一直通到海边。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yìzhí tōngdào hǎibiān.
examples.en: This road goes all the way to the seaside.

examples.zh: 他一直很关心身边的每一个人。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí hěn guānxīn shēnbiān de měi yí ge rén.
examples.en: He's always cared about everyone around him.

examples.zh: 我一直没勇气告诉你真相。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí méi yǒngqì gàosù nǐ zhēnxiàng.
examples.en: I've never had the courage to tell you the truth.

examples.zh: 这么多年,她的笑容一直没变。
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō nián, tā de xiàoróng yìzhí méi biàn.
examples.en: After all these years, her smile hasn't changed.

examples.zh: 我们一直朝着同一个目标努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìzhí cháozhe tóng yí ge mùbiāo nǔlì.
examples.en: We've always been working toward the same goal.

examples.zh: 他一直很低调,从不炫耀自己。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí hěn dīdiào, cóng bù xuànyào zìjǐ.
examples.en: He's always kept a low profile and never shows off.

examples.zh: 这些照片我一直好好保存着。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn wǒ yìzhí hǎohǎo bǎocúnzhe.
examples.en: I've kept these photos carefully all this time.

examples.zh: 不管发生什么,我都会一直在你身边。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn fāshēng shénme, wǒ dōu huì yìzhí zài nǐ shēnbiān.
examples.en: No matter what happens, I'll always be by your side.

title: "已经...了" ile "artık / çoktan"
summary: "已经...了" (yǐjīng...le) bir eylem/durumun çoktan gerçekleştiğini belirtir: 他已经走了 = O çoktan gitti.
explanation: "已经" (zaten/çoktan) bir şeyin daha önce tamamlandığını/gerçekleştiğini vurgular ve genellikle cümle sonundaki "了" ile birlikte kullanılır: 我已经吃了 (çoktan yedim). "已经" fiilden önce, "了" sonda gelir. Yaş/miktar gibi durum değişimlerinde de kullanılır: 他已经三十岁了 (o artık otuz yaşında). Olumsuzda genellikle "已经不...了" (artık ...değil) kalıbı kullanılır.

examples.zh: 你来晚了,他已经走了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái wǎn le, tā yǐjīng zǒu le.
examples.en: You're late, he's already left.

examples.zh: 我已经把作业做完了,可以出去玩了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ zuòyè zuòwán le, kěyǐ chūqù wán le.
examples.en: I've already finished my homework, I can go out and play.

examples.zh: 孩子已经长大了,有自己的想法了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yǐjīng zhǎngdà le, yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ le.
examples.en: The child has grown up and has his own ideas now.

examples.zh: 我们已经认识十年了,时间过得真快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng rènshi shí nián le, shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài.
examples.en: We've known each other for ten years already, time flies.

examples.zh: 对不起,票已经卖完了。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, piào yǐjīng màiwán le.
examples.en: Sorry, the tickets are already sold out.

examples.zh: 天已经黑了,我们该回家了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān yǐjīng hēi le, wǒmen gāi huíjiā le.
examples.en: It's already dark, we should head home.

examples.zh: 我已经不生你的气了,别担心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bù shēng nǐ de qì le, bié dānxīn.
examples.en: I'm not angry with you anymore, don't worry.

examples.zh: 他已经决定了,谁也劝不动。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng juédìng le, shéi yě quàn bu dòng.
examples.en: He's already decided, no one can persuade him otherwise.

examples.zh: 我已经等了半个小时了,他还没来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng děng le bàn ge xiǎoshí le, tā hái méi lái.
examples.en: I've been waiting half an hour and he still hasn't come.

examples.zh: 这件事已经过去了,你就别再想了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǐjīng guòqù le, nǐ jiù bié zài xiǎng le.
examples.en: This is already in the past, stop thinking about it.

examples.zh: 我已经习惯了这里的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xíguàn le zhèlǐ de shēnghuó.
examples.en: I've already gotten used to life here.

examples.zh: 他已经是两个孩子的父亲了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng shì liǎng ge háizi de fùqīn le.
examples.en: He's already a father of two.

examples.zh: 外面已经下起雨来了,你带伞了吗？
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǐjīng xià qǐ yǔ lái le, nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
examples.en: It's already started raining outside, did you bring an umbrella?

examples.zh: 我们已经尽力了,剩下的看运气吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng jìnlì le, shèngxià de kàn yùnqì ba.
examples.en: We've already done our best, the rest is up to luck.

examples.zh: 他已经很久没有联系我了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng hěn jiǔ méiyǒu liánxì wǒ le.
examples.en: He hasn't contacted me for a long time now.

examples.zh: 这个问题我们已经讨论过很多次了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí wǒmen yǐjīng tǎolùnguò hěn duō cì le.
examples.en: We've already discussed this problem many times.

examples.zh: 我已经把该说的话都说了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ gāi shuō de huà dōu shuō le.
examples.en: I've already said everything I needed to say.

examples.zh: 这些菜已经凉了,我去热一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài yǐjīng liáng le, wǒ qù rè yíxià.
examples.en: These dishes have already gone cold, I'll go heat them up.

examples.zh: 他已经不是原来那个胆小的孩子了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bú shì yuánlái nàge dǎnxiǎo de háizi le.
examples.en: He's no longer the timid child he used to be.

examples.zh: 我已经受不了这样的生活了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng shòubuliǎo zhèyàng de shēnghuó le.
examples.en: I can't stand this kind of life anymore.

examples.zh: 你已经做得很好了,不用太自责。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐjīng zuò de hěn hǎo le, búyòng tài zìzé.
examples.en: You've already done very well, don't blame yourself too much.

examples.zh: 这本书我已经看了三遍了,还是很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ yǐjīng kàn le sān biàn le, háishì hěn xǐhuan.
examples.en: I've read this book three times already and still love it.

examples.zh: 事情已经这样了,后悔也没用。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing yǐjīng zhèyàng le, hòuhuǐ yě méiyòng.
examples.en: Things are already like this, regretting is useless.

examples.zh: 他已经答应了,应该不会反悔。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng dāying le, yīnggāi bú huì fǎnhuǐ.
examples.en: He's already agreed, he shouldn't go back on his word.

examples.zh: 我已经原谅他了,你也别放在心上了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng yuánliàng tā le, nǐ yě bié fàng zài xīn shàng le.
examples.en: I've already forgiven him, so don't dwell on it either.

title: "总是" ile "her zaman / hep"
summary: "总是" (zǒngshì) tekrar eden, alışkanlık haline gelmiş bir durumu anlatır: 他总是迟到 = O hep geç kalır.
explanation: "总是" bir eylemin sürekli/her defasında tekrarlandığını belirtir — genellikle bir alışkanlık ya da can sıkıcı bir eğilim: 你总是忘带钥匙 (hep anahtarını unutuyorsun). "一直"'ten farkı: "一直" kesintisiz tek bir süreç, "总是" ise tekrar eden ayrı olaylardır. Olumsuzu "总是不" (hep yapmaz) ya da "不总是" (her zaman değil). Konuşmada "老是" (lǎoshì) de aynı anlamda kullanılır.

examples.zh: 他总是迟到,大家都习惯了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì chídào, dàjiā dōu xíguàn le.
examples.en: He's always late, everyone's used to it.

examples.zh: 你总是这么粗心,难怪总丢东西。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒngshì zhème cūxīn, nánguài zǒng diū dōngxi.
examples.en: You're always so careless, no wonder you keep losing things.

examples.zh: 妈妈总是把最好的留给我。
examples.pinyin: Māma zǒngshì bǎ zuì hǎo de liú gěi wǒ.
examples.en: Mom always saves the best for me.

examples.zh: 他总是笑着面对生活中的困难。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì xiàozhe miànduì shēnghuó zhōng de kùnnan.
examples.en: He always faces life's difficulties with a smile.

examples.zh: 你为什么总是不听我的话？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme zǒngshì bù tīng wǒ de huà?
examples.en: Why do you never listen to me?

examples.zh: 这个孩子总是问一些奇怪的问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi zǒngshì wèn yìxiē qíguài de wèntí.
examples.en: This child always asks strange questions.

examples.zh: 她总是在别人需要的时候伸出援手。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zài biérén xūyào de shíhou shēnchū yuánshǒu.
examples.en: She always lends a hand when others need it.

examples.zh: 他总是把工作看得比什么都重要。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì bǎ gōngzuò kàn de bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
examples.en: He always regards work as more important than anything.

examples.zh: 你不能总是靠别人,要学会独立。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng zǒngshì kào biérén, yào xuéhuì dúlì.
examples.en: You can't always rely on others, you need to be independent.

examples.zh: 我总是记不住他的名字。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǒngshì jì bu zhù tā de míngzi.
examples.en: I can never remember his name.

examples.zh: 每次考试前他总是特别紧张。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kǎoshì qián tā zǒngshì tèbié jǐnzhāng.
examples.en: He always gets especially nervous before each exam.

examples.zh: 她总是为别人着想,很少想到自己。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì wèi biérén zhuóxiǎng, hěn shǎo xiǎngdào zìjǐ.
examples.en: She always thinks of others, rarely of herself.

examples.zh: 你总是这样,答应了又忘。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒngshì zhèyàng, dāying le yòu wàng.
examples.en: You're always like this, you agree and then forget.

examples.zh: 他总是最后一个离开办公室。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì zuìhòu yí ge líkāi bàngōngshì.
examples.en: He's always the last to leave the office.

examples.zh: 生活总是充满了各种意外。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó zǒngshì chōngmǎn le gèzhǒng yìwài.
examples.en: Life is always full of surprises.

examples.zh: 她总是穿得很朴素,可是很有气质。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì chuān de hěn pǔsù, kěshì hěn yǒu qìzhì.
examples.en: She always dresses plainly but has real elegance.

examples.zh: 你总是往坏处想,难怪不开心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒngshì wǎng huàichù xiǎng, nánguài bù kāixīn.
examples.en: You always think of the worst, no wonder you're unhappy.

examples.zh: 他做事总是很有计划,从不慌乱。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì zǒngshì hěn yǒu jìhuà, cóng bù huāngluàn.
examples.en: He always works with a plan and never panics.

examples.zh: 这条路总是很堵,我们换一条吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù zǒngshì hěn dǔ, wǒmen huàn yì tiáo ba.
examples.en: This road is always jammed, let's take another one.

examples.zh: 父母总是希望孩子能过得比自己好。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì xīwàng háizi néng guò de bǐ zìjǐ hǎo.
examples.en: Parents always hope their children will live better than themselves.

examples.zh: 你总是把简单的事情想得太复杂。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiǎndān de shìqing xiǎng de tài fùzá.
examples.en: You always overcomplicate simple things.

examples.zh: 他总是能在关键时刻做出正确的决定。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì néng zài guānjiàn shíkè zuòchū zhèngquè de juédìng.
examples.en: He always makes the right decision at crucial moments.

examples.zh: 我总是在深夜才有灵感。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǒngshì zài shēnyè cái yǒu línggǎn.
examples.en: I always get inspiration only late at night.

examples.zh: 她总是那么温柔,从来不对人发脾气。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì nàme wēnróu, cónglái bú duì rén fā píqi.
examples.en: She's always so gentle and never loses her temper.

examples.zh: 好运不会总是站在你这边,要靠实力。
examples.pinyin: Hǎoyùn bú huì zǒngshì zhàn zài nǐ zhè biān, yào kào shílì.
examples.en: Luck won't always be on your side, you have to rely on ability.

title: "还" ile "hâlâ / bir de / ayrıca"
summary: "还" (hái) "hâlâ / bir de / ayrıca" anlamlarında ekleme veya devam bildirir: 我还有一个问题 = Bir sorum daha var.
explanation: "还" çok işlevli bir zarftır: (1) Ekleme/dahası: "她会说英文,还会说法文" (İngilizce, bir de Fransızca konuşur). (2) Süregelen durum "hâlâ": "他还在睡觉" (hâlâ uyuyor). (3) "还有" ile "bir de/ayrıca" bağlacı. Fiil/sıfattan önce gelir. Tonlamaya göre "beklenenden fazla" ya da "henüz" nüansları katar. Miktar/ekleme anlamında çok yaygındır.

examples.zh: 我还有一个问题想问你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǒu yí ge wèntí xiǎng wèn nǐ.
examples.en: I have one more question to ask you.

examples.zh: 这么晚了,他还在办公室加班。
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, tā hái zài bàngōngshì jiābān.
examples.en: It's so late and he's still working overtime at the office.

examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴,还会拉小提琴。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tán gāngqín, hái huì lā xiǎotíqín.
examples.en: She can play piano, and also violin.

examples.zh: 除了工作,他还要照顾生病的父母。
examples.pinyin: Chúle gōngzuò, tā hái yào zhàogù shēngbìng de fùmǔ.
examples.en: Besides work, he also has to care for his sick parents.

examples.zh: 你的作业还没做完,怎么就出去玩了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zuòyè hái méi zuòwán, zěnme jiù chūqù wán le?
examples.en: Your homework isn't done yet, how did you go out to play?

examples.zh: 这道菜还不错,你要不要再点一份？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài hái búcuò, nǐ yào bu yào zài diǎn yí fèn?
examples.en: This dish is pretty good, do you want to order another?

examples.zh: 天还没亮,他就已经出门了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hái méi liàng, tā jiù yǐjīng chūmén le.
examples.en: It wasn't even light out yet, and he'd already gone out.

examples.zh: 我买了水果,还买了一些蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le shuǐguǒ, hái mǎi le yìxiē shūcài.
examples.en: I bought fruit, and also some vegetables.

examples.zh: 他不但学习好,还很会运动。
examples.pinyin: Tā búdàn xuéxí hǎo, hái hěn huì yùndòng.
examples.en: He not only studies well but is also good at sports.

examples.zh: 这件事还没有结束,我们不能放松。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hái méiyǒu jiéshù, wǒmen bù néng fàngsōng.
examples.en: This isn't over yet, we can't let our guard down.

examples.zh: 外面还在下雨,你再等一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hái zài xiàyǔ, nǐ zài děng yíhuìr ba.
examples.en: It's still raining outside, wait a bit longer.

examples.zh: 我还想在这个城市多待几天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái xiǎng zài zhège chéngshì duō dāi jǐ tiān.
examples.en: I'd like to stay a few more days in this city.

examples.zh: 他年纪不大,懂的道理还真不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánjì bú dà, dǒng de dàolǐ hái zhēn bù shǎo.
examples.en: He's not old, yet he understands quite a lot.

examples.zh: 除了中文,你还会说别的语言吗？
examples.pinyin: Chúle Zhōngwén, nǐ hái huì shuō biéde yǔyán ma?
examples.en: Besides Chinese, can you speak other languages?

examples.zh: 我们还有很长的路要走,别灰心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hái yǒu hěn cháng de lù yào zǒu, bié huīxīn.
examples.en: We still have a long way to go, don't lose heart.

examples.zh: 这本书我还没看完,你先别拿走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ hái méi kànwán, nǐ xiān bié názǒu.
examples.en: I haven't finished this book, don't take it away yet.

examples.zh: 他都八十岁了,身体还这么好。
examples.pinyin: Tā dōu bāshí suì le, shēntǐ hái zhème hǎo.
examples.en: He's already eighty and still so healthy.

examples.zh: 你还记得我们小时候一起玩的地方吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái jìde wǒmen xiǎoshíhou yìqǐ wán de dìfang ma?
examples.en: Do you still remember where we played as kids?

examples.zh: 这里还有一个空位,你坐这儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ hái yǒu yí ge kòngwèi, nǐ zuò zhèr ba.
examples.en: There's still an empty seat here, sit here.

examples.zh: 事情还没到最坏的地步,别太悲观。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing hái méi dào zuì huài de dìbù, bié tài bēiguān.
examples.en: Things haven't reached the worst point yet, don't be too pessimistic.

examples.zh: 你还这么年轻,机会多得是。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái zhème niánqīng, jīhuì duō de shì.
examples.en: You're still so young, there are plenty of opportunities.

examples.zh: 我付了房租,还剩下一点钱买吃的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fù le fángzū, hái shèngxià yìdiǎn qián mǎi chī de.
examples.en: After paying rent, I have a little money left for food.

examples.zh: 他现在还不知道这个坏消息。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiànzài hái bù zhīdào zhège huài xiāoxi.
examples.en: He still doesn't know this bad news.

examples.zh: 你还有什么想说的,一次说完吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái yǒu shénme xiǎng shuō de, yí cì shuōwán ba.
examples.en: Whatever else you want to say, say it all at once.

examples.zh: 这么难的事他都做到了,还有什么做不到？
examples.pinyin: Zhème nán de shì tā dōu zuòdào le, hái yǒu shénme zuò bu dào?
examples.en: He managed something this hard, what can't he do?

title: "刚" ile "az önce / yeni"
summary: "刚" (gāng) bir eylemin az önce/henüz gerçekleştiğini belirtir: 我刚到 = Az önce vardım.
explanation: "刚" bir eylemin çok kısa süre önce olduğunu anlatan zarftır: 他刚走 (az önce gitti), 我刚吃完饭 (yeni yemek yedim). Fiilden hemen önce gelir. "刚才" (gāngcái) ise bir ZAMAN İSMİdir ("az önce") ve cümlede özneyle fiil arasında ya da başta durabilir; "刚" ise sadece zarftır. "刚刚" (gānggāng) "刚"'ın vurgulu biçimidir, aynı anlama gelir.

examples.zh: 我刚到家,还没来得及换衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dào jiā, hái méi láidejí huàn yīfu.
examples.en: I just got home, haven't had time to change clothes.

examples.zh: 他刚走,你要是早来五分钟就能见到他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng zǒu, nǐ yàoshi zǎo lái wǔ fēnzhōng jiù néng jiàndào tā.
examples.en: He just left; if you'd come five minutes earlier you'd have caught him.

examples.zh: 孩子刚睡着,请你们小声一点。
examples.pinyin: Háizi gāng shuìzháo, qǐng nǐmen xiǎoshēng yìdiǎn.
examples.en: The child just fell asleep, please keep your voices down.

examples.zh: 我刚吃完饭,现在不太想动。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng chīwán fàn, xiànzài bú tài xiǎng dòng.
examples.en: I just finished eating, I don't feel like moving now.

examples.zh: 这件事我也是刚知道,还没来得及告诉你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yěshì gāng zhīdào, hái méi láidejí gàosù nǐ.
examples.en: I just found out about this too, haven't had time to tell you.

examples.zh: 他刚从国外回来,还在倒时差。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng cóng guówài huílái, hái zài dǎo shíchā.
examples.en: He just came back from abroad, still getting over jet lag.

examples.zh: 雨刚停,地上还是湿的。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ gāng tíng, dìshang háishì shī de.
examples.en: The rain just stopped, the ground is still wet.

examples.zh: 我们刚认识不久,还不太熟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gāng rènshi bùjiǔ, hái bú tài shú.
examples.en: We just met not long ago, we're not that close yet.

examples.zh: 我刚想给你打电话,你就来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng xiǎng gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà, nǐ jiù lái le.
examples.en: I was just about to call you, and here you are.

examples.zh: 公司刚成立的时候只有三个人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gāng chénglì de shíhou zhǐyǒu sān ge rén.
examples.en: When the company was just founded, there were only three people.

examples.zh: 他刚毕业,还没有工作经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng bìyè, hái méiyǒu gōngzuò jīngyàn.
examples.en: He just graduated and has no work experience yet.

examples.zh: 我刚把房间收拾好,你别弄乱了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng bǎ fángjiān shōushi hǎo, nǐ bié nòngluàn le.
examples.en: I just tidied up the room, don't mess it up.

examples.zh: 太阳刚升起来,山上还有一层薄雾。
examples.pinyin: Tàiyáng gāng shēng qǐlái, shān shàng háiyǒu yì céng bó wù.
examples.en: The sun just rose, there's still a thin mist on the mountain.

examples.zh: 她刚哭过,眼睛还是红的。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng kūguò, yǎnjing háishì hóng de.
examples.en: She just cried, her eyes are still red.

examples.zh: 我刚搬来这里,对周围还不熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng bān lái zhèlǐ, duì zhōuwéi hái bù shúxī.
examples.en: I just moved here, I'm not familiar with the area yet.

examples.zh: 会议刚结束,大家都还没走。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì gāng jiéshù, dàjiā dōu hái méi zǒu.
examples.en: The meeting just ended, no one has left yet.

examples.zh: 我刚要出门,天就下起了大雨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng yào chūmén, tiān jiù xià qǐ le dàyǔ.
examples.en: Just as I was about to leave, it started pouring.

examples.zh: 这台机器刚修好,应该能用了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì gāng xiūhǎo, yīnggāi néng yòng le.
examples.en: This machine was just fixed, it should work now.

examples.zh: 他刚开始学中文的时候连声调都分不清。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng kāishǐ xué Zhōngwén de shíhou lián shēngdiào dōu fēn bu qīng.
examples.en: When he just started learning Chinese, he couldn't even tell the tones apart.

examples.zh: 我刚说完这句话就后悔了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng shuōwán zhè jù huà jiù hòuhuǐ le.
examples.en: I regretted it the moment I finished saying this.

examples.zh: 这个消息是刚刚传来的,还没证实。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi shì gānggāng chuánlái de, hái méi zhèngshí.
examples.en: This news just came in, it hasn't been confirmed.

examples.zh: 孩子刚学会走路,走得还不太稳。
examples.pinyin: Háizi gāng xuéhuì zǒulù, zǒu de hái bú tài wěn.
examples.en: The child just learned to walk, still a bit unsteady.

examples.zh: 我刚洗完的衣服,又被雨淋湿了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng xǐwán de yīfu, yòu bèi yǔ lín shī le.
examples.en: The clothes I just washed got soaked by the rain again.

examples.zh: 他刚坐下,电话就响了。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng zuòxià, diànhuà jiù xiǎng le.
examples.en: He just sat down and the phone rang.

examples.zh: 我们的关系刚刚有点好转,别又吵架了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de guānxi gānggāng yǒudiǎn hǎozhuǎn, bié yòu chǎojià le.
examples.en: Our relationship just started to improve, let's not fight again.

title: "只" ile "sadece / yalnızca"
summary: "只" (zhǐ) bir şeyi tek/sınırlı olarak belirtir: 我只有一个妹妹 = Sadece bir kız kardeşim var.
explanation: "只" "sadece, yalnızca, tek" anlamı veren zarftır ve sınırladığı fiil/ifadeden hemen önce gelir: 我只想休息 (sadece dinlenmek istiyorum). Miktar sınırlaması için çok yaygındır: 只有 (sadece ... var), 只要 (yeter ki), 只是 (yalnızca / ama). "只" ile "就" birlikte sık kullanılır. Sınırladığı öge fiilden sonraysa dikkatli konumlandırmak gerekir.

examples.zh: 我只想安安静静地过日子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng ān'ānjìngjìng de guò rìzi.
examples.en: I just want to live a quiet life.

examples.zh: 我们家只有我一个孩子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí ge háizi.
examples.en: I'm the only child in our family.

examples.zh: 这件事只有你我两个人知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zhǐ yǒu nǐ wǒ liǎng ge rén zhīdào.
examples.en: Only you and I know about this.

examples.zh: 我只是随便说说,你别当真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì suíbiàn shuōshuo, nǐ bié dàngzhēn.
examples.en: I was just saying it casually, don't take it seriously.

examples.zh: 只要你努力,就一定会有收获。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù yídìng huì yǒu shōuhuò.
examples.en: As long as you work hard, you'll surely gain something.

examples.zh: 他只关心自己,从不为别人着想。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ guānxīn zìjǐ, cóng bù wèi biérén zhuóxiǎng.
examples.en: He only cares about himself and never thinks of others.

examples.zh: 这些钱只够买一张票。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē qián zhǐ gòu mǎi yì zhāng piào.
examples.en: This money is only enough for one ticket.

examples.zh: 我只见过他一面,不太了解他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ jiànguò tā yí miàn, bú tài liǎojiě tā.
examples.en: I've only met him once, I don't know him well.

examples.zh: 人生只有一次,要好好珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng zhǐ yǒu yí cì, yào hǎohǎo zhēnxī.
examples.en: Life happens only once, cherish it well.

examples.zh: 我只是想帮你,没有别的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng bāng nǐ, méiyǒu biéde yìsi.
examples.en: I just wanted to help you, nothing more.

examples.zh: 这条路只能走一个人,你先过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù zhǐ néng zǒu yí ge rén, nǐ xiān guò.
examples.en: This path fits only one person, you go first.

examples.zh: 他什么都不缺,只缺一点耐心。
examples.pinyin: Tā shénme dōu bù quē, zhǐ quē yìdiǎn nàixīn.
examples.en: He lacks nothing except a bit of patience.

examples.zh: 我只希望你能平平安安的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xīwàng nǐ néng píngpíng'ān'ān de.
examples.en: I only hope you'll be safe and sound.

examples.zh: 这家店只在周末营业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhǐ zài zhōumò yíngyè.
examples.en: This shop is only open on weekends.

examples.zh: 我只用了一个小时就把它做完了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù bǎ tā zuòwán le.
examples.en: I finished it in just one hour.

examples.zh: 钱只是问题的一部分,更难的是感情。
examples.pinyin: Qián zhǐshì wèntí de yíbùfen, gèng nán de shì gǎnqíng.
examples.en: Money is only part of the problem; the harder part is feelings.

examples.zh: 他只说了一句话就转身走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ shuō le yí jù huà jiù zhuǎnshēn zǒu le.
examples.en: He said only one sentence and then turned and left.

examples.zh: 真正的朋友,一生中只有几个。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou, yìshēng zhōng zhǐ yǒu jǐ ge.
examples.en: You only have a few true friends in a lifetime.

examples.zh: 我只要一杯水就够了,谢谢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ yào yì bēi shuǐ jiù gòu le, xièxie.
examples.en: I only need a glass of water, thank you.

examples.zh: 这个道理很简单,只是很多人做不到。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàolǐ hěn jiǎndān, zhǐshì hěn duō rén zuò bu dào.
examples.en: This principle is simple, only that many can't follow it.

examples.zh: 他只顾着玩手机,连饭都忘了吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐ gùzhe wán shǒujī, lián fàn dōu wàng le chī.
examples.en: He was only busy on his phone and even forgot to eat.

examples.zh: 我只是有点累,休息一下就好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì yǒudiǎn lèi, xiūxi yíxià jiù hǎo.
examples.en: I'm just a bit tired, I'll be fine after a rest.

examples.zh: 成功只属于那些不放弃的人。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng zhǐ shǔyú nàxiē bú fàngqì de rén.
examples.en: Success belongs only to those who don't give up.

examples.zh: 这么多年,他心里只有你一个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō nián, tā xīnlǐ zhǐ yǒu nǐ yí ge rén.
examples.en: After all these years, you're the only one in his heart.

examples.zh: 别难过了,这只是一个小小的挫折。
examples.pinyin: Bié nánguò le, zhè zhǐshì yí ge xiǎoxiǎo de cuòzhé.
examples.en: Don't be sad, this is just a small setback.

title: "就" ile "hemen / o zaman / işte"
summary: "就" (jiù) çok işlevli bir zarftır: eylemin çabuk/hemen olduğunu, koşul sonucunu ya da vurguyu belirtir: 我马上就来 = Hemen geliyorum.
explanation: "就" Çince'nin en esnek zarflarından biridir: (1) çabukluk/erkenlik: "他六点就起床了" (daha altıda kalkmıştı). (2) koşul-sonuç bağlacı: "你不去,我就去" (sen gitmezsen, o zaman ben giderim). (3) vurgu/kesinlik: "这就是我要的" (işte tam da bunu istiyordum). Genellikle "要是/如果...就", "只要...就" gibi kalıplarda ikinci parçadır. Fiilden hemen önce gelir.

examples.zh: 你等我一下,我马上就来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děng wǒ yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.en: Wait a moment, I'll be right there.

examples.zh: 如果你累了,就先回去休息吧。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ lèi le, jiù xiān huíqù xiūxi ba.
examples.en: If you're tired, go back and rest first.

examples.zh: 这就是我一直在找的那本书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiùshì wǒ yìzhí zài zhǎo de nà běn shū.
examples.en: This is exactly the book I've been looking for.

examples.zh: 他每天六点就起床跑步。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng pǎobù.
examples.en: He gets up to run as early as six every day.

examples.zh: 只要你开口,我就会帮你。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ kāikǒu, wǒ jiù huì bāng nǐ.
examples.en: As long as you ask, I'll help you.

examples.zh: 我一看就知道是他做的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí kàn jiù zhīdào shì tā zuò de.
examples.en: I knew it was his doing at a glance.

examples.zh: 你不用担心,这点小事我一个人就能搞定。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng dānxīn, zhè diǎn xiǎoshì wǒ yí ge rén jiù néng gǎodìng.
examples.en: Don't worry, I can handle this little thing on my own.

examples.zh: 要是明天天气好,我们就去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.
examples.en: If the weather's good tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

examples.zh: 他说完就走了,一句解释都没有。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōwán jiù zǒu le, yí jù jiěshì dōu méiyǒu.
examples.en: He left right after speaking, without a word of explanation.

examples.zh: 这道题其实很简单,你想一想就会了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí qíshí hěn jiǎndān, nǐ xiǎng yi xiǎng jiù huì le.
examples.en: This problem is actually simple, you'll get it if you think about it.

examples.zh: 我们俩一见面就聊个不停。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ yí jiànmiàn jiù liáo ge bù tíng.
examples.en: The two of us start chatting nonstop the moment we meet.

examples.zh: 你放心,我说到就一定做到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ shuōdào jiù yídìng zuòdào.
examples.en: Don't worry, if I say I'll do it, I will.

examples.zh: 天刚亮他就出发了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān gāng liàng tā jiù chūfā le.
examples.en: He set off as soon as day broke.

examples.zh: 如果你不同意,那我们就换一个方案。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù tóngyì, nà wǒmen jiù huàn yí ge fāng'àn.
examples.en: If you don't agree, then we'll switch to another plan.

examples.zh: 这就是生活,有苦也有甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiùshì shēnghuó, yǒu kǔ yě yǒu tián.
examples.en: This is life, with its bitterness and sweetness.

examples.zh: 他一紧张就说不出话来。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì jǐnzhāng jiù shuō bu chū huà lái.
examples.en: He becomes speechless the moment he gets nervous.

examples.zh: 只要方向对了,慢一点也没关系。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào fāngxiàng duì le, màn yìdiǎn yě méi guānxi.
examples.en: As long as the direction is right, being a bit slow is fine.

examples.zh: 你要是喜欢就拿去吧,我不需要了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi xǐhuan jiù ná qù ba, wǒ bù xūyào le.
examples.en: If you like it, take it, I don't need it anymore.

examples.zh: 从这里到公司走路十分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào gōngsī zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.en: It's only a ten-minute walk from here to the office.

examples.zh: 我早就想跟你说这件事了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎng gēn nǐ shuō zhè jiàn shì le.
examples.en: I've long wanted to tell you about this.

examples.zh: 他一有空就去图书馆看书。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì yǒu kòng jiù qù túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.en: Whenever he's free, he goes to the library to read.

examples.zh: 事情没你想的那么难,试一次就明白了。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing méi nǐ xiǎng de nàme nán, shì yí cì jiù míngbai le.
examples.en: It's not as hard as you think; try once and you'll get it.

examples.zh: 这件衣服你穿上就特别好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ chuān shàng jiù tèbié hǎokàn.
examples.en: You look especially good the moment you put this on.

examples.zh: 只要一家人在一起,在哪儿都是家。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào yìjiā rén zài yìqǐ, zài nǎr dōu shì jiā.
examples.en: As long as the family is together, anywhere is home.

examples.zh: 我一想到明天要考试就睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì xiǎngdào míngtiān yào kǎoshì jiù shuì bu zháo.
examples.en: The moment I think of tomorrow's exam, I can't sleep.

title: "(正)在" ile süregelen eylem
summary: "在" (zài) fiilden önce gelerek eylemin şu anda sürdüğünü anlatır: 我在吃饭 = Yemek yiyorum (şu anda).
explanation: Şu anda devam eden bir eylem için fiilin önüne "在" konur: 他在睡觉 (uyuyor). Vurgu için başına "正" eklenebilir: 正在 (tam da ...iyor). Cümle sonuna bazen "呢" gelir ve süregelmişliği yumuşatır: 我在看书呢. Olumsuzu "没在" veya "不在...": 我没在睡觉 (uyumuyorum). Bu, "在 + yer" (bir yerde bulunma) yapısından farklıdır; burada "在"'dan sonra FİİL gelir.

examples.zh: 你小声点,孩子正在睡觉呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎoshēng diǎn, háizi zhèngzài shuìjiào ne.
examples.en: Keep it down, the child is sleeping.

examples.zh: 我在做饭,你先坐一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zuòfàn, nǐ xiān zuò yíhuìr.
examples.en: I'm cooking, sit for a bit first.

examples.zh: 他正在打电话,等一下再问他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài dǎ diànhuà, děng yíxià zài wèn tā.
examples.en: He's on the phone, ask him in a moment.

examples.zh: 外面正在下大雨,你别出去了。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn zhèngzài xià dàyǔ, nǐ bié chūqù le.
examples.en: It's pouring outside, don't go out.

examples.zh: 我给他打电话的时候,他正在开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā dǎ diànhuà de shíhou, tā zhèngzài kāihuì.
examples.en: When I called him, he was in a meeting.

examples.zh: 孩子们在花园里玩,笑得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài huāyuán lǐ wán, xiào de hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: The children are playing in the garden, laughing happily.

examples.zh: 我正在想这个问题,你别打扰我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài xiǎng zhège wèntí, nǐ bié dǎrǎo wǒ.
examples.en: I'm thinking about this problem, don't disturb me.

examples.zh: 你来的时候我正在洗澡,没听到门铃。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de shíhou wǒ zhèngzài xǐzǎo, méi tīngdào ménlíng.
examples.en: When you came I was showering, I didn't hear the doorbell.

examples.zh: 世界在变,我们也要跟着改变。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè zài biàn, wǒmen yě yào gēnzhe gǎibiàn.
examples.en: The world is changing, and we must change with it.

examples.zh: 他正在努力学习,准备下个月的考试。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài nǔlì xuéxí, zhǔnbèi xià ge yuè de kǎoshì.
examples.en: He's studying hard, preparing for next month's exam.

examples.zh: 我没在看电视,我在写作业。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi zài kàn diànshì, wǒ zài xiě zuòyè.
examples.en: I'm not watching TV, I'm doing homework.

examples.zh: 这家公司正在招人,你可以去试试。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài zhāo rén, nǐ kěyǐ qù shìshi.
examples.en: This company is hiring, you could give it a try.

examples.zh: 她正在跟朋友聊天,聊得很起劲。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài gēn péngyou liáotiān, liáo de hěn qǐjìn.
examples.en: She's chatting with friends, quite animatedly.

examples.zh: 我进去的时候,他正在收拾行李。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìnqù de shíhou, tā zhèngzài shōushi xíngli.
examples.en: When I went in, he was packing his luggage.

examples.zh: 医生正在给病人看病,请在外面等。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng zhèngzài gěi bìngrén kànbìng, qǐng zài wàimiàn děng.
examples.en: The doctor is seeing a patient, please wait outside.

examples.zh: 我正在找工作,还没有合适的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài zhǎo gōngzuò, hái méiyǒu héshì de.
examples.en: I'm looking for a job, haven't found a suitable one yet.

examples.zh: 你看,天上的云正在慢慢移动。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, tiān shàng de yún zhèngzài mànman yídòng.
examples.en: Look, the clouds in the sky are slowly moving.

examples.zh: 大家都在等你,你快点儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài děng nǐ, nǐ kuài diǎnr ba.
examples.en: Everyone is waiting for you, hurry up.

examples.zh: 他正在经历人生中最难的阶段。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài jīnglì rénshēng zhōng zuì nán de jiēduàn.
examples.en: He's going through the hardest stage of his life.

examples.zh: 我们正在讨论明天的安排。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài tǎolùn míngtiān de ānpái.
examples.en: We're discussing tomorrow's arrangements.

examples.zh: 雪还在下,路上已经白了一片。
examples.pinyin: Xuě hái zài xià, lùshang yǐjīng bái le yí piàn.
examples.en: It's still snowing, the road is already all white.

examples.zh: 我正在学做这道菜,还不太熟练。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài xué zuò zhè dào cài, hái bú tài shúliàn.
examples.en: I'm learning to make this dish, still not skilled.

examples.zh: 他正在专心地画画,没注意到我进来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài zhuānxīn de huàhuà, méi zhùyìdào wǒ jìnlái.
examples.en: He's focused on painting, didn't notice me come in.

examples.zh: 我们的关系正在慢慢变好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de guānxi zhèngzài mànman biàn hǎo.
examples.en: Our relationship is slowly getting better.

examples.zh: 你打电话来的时候,我正在路上呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ diànhuà lái de shíhou, wǒ zhèngzài lùshang ne.
examples.en: When you called, I was on my way.

title: "别" ile olumsuz emir
summary: "别" (bié) bir eylemi yapmamayı söyleyen kısa, samimi olumsuz emirdir: 别走！ = Gitme!
explanation: "别", "不要"'nun kısa ve daha gündelik biçimidir; anlamı aynıdır: 别哭 (ağlama), 别担心 (merak etme). Cümle sonuna "了" eklenerek süregelen bir eylemin durdurulması istenir: 别说了 (artık söyleme/yeter). Nazik rica için başına "请" gelir. "别" ayrıca "别忘了" (unutma), "别客气" (rica ederim) gibi kalıplarda çok yaygındır.

examples.zh: 别难过了,一切都会好起来的。
examples.pinyin: Bié nánguò le, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de.
examples.en: Don't be sad, everything will get better.

examples.zh: 这是秘密,你别告诉别人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì mìmì, nǐ bié gàosù biérén.
examples.en: This is a secret, don't tell anyone.

examples.zh: 别着急,慢慢说,我在听。
examples.pinyin: Bié zháojí, mànman shuō, wǒ zài tīng.
examples.en: Don't rush, speak slowly, I'm listening.

examples.zh: 外面很危险,你一个人别去。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn wēixiǎn, nǐ yí ge rén bié qù.
examples.en: It's dangerous out there, don't go alone.

examples.zh: 别忘了明天早上八点开会。
examples.pinyin: Bié wàng le míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: Don't forget the meeting at eight tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 别客气,自己家一样,想吃什么就拿。
examples.pinyin: Bié kèqi, zìjǐ jiā yíyàng, xiǎng chī shénme jiù ná.
examples.en: Don't be shy, make yourself at home, take whatever you want.

examples.zh: 你别生气了,我不是故意的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié shēngqì le, wǒ bú shì gùyì de.
examples.en: Don't be angry, I didn't do it on purpose.

examples.zh: 别把事情想得太复杂,其实很简单。
examples.pinyin: Bié bǎ shìqing xiǎng de tài fùzá, qíshí hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: Don't overthink it, it's actually simple.

examples.zh: 孩子在睡觉,你们说话别太大声。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zài shuìjiào, nǐmen shuōhuà bié tài dàshēng.
examples.en: The child is sleeping, don't talk too loudly.

examples.zh: 别浪费时间了,我们赶快开始吧。
examples.pinyin: Bié làngfèi shíjiān le, wǒmen gǎnkuài kāishǐ ba.
examples.en: Stop wasting time, let's start quickly.

examples.zh: 你别太累了,身体最重要。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié tài lèi le, shēntǐ zuì zhòngyào.
examples.en: Don't overwork yourself, health is most important.

examples.zh: 别管别人怎么说,做你自己就好。
examples.pinyin: Bié guǎn biérén zěnme shuō, zuò nǐ zìjǐ jiù hǎo.
examples.en: Don't mind what others say, just be yourself.

examples.zh: 这件事别放在心上,过去就过去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì bié fàng zài xīn shàng, guòqù jiù guòqù le.
examples.en: Don't take this to heart, the past is the past.

examples.zh: 你别动,我帮你把虫子拿开。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dòng, wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ chóngzi ná kāi.
examples.en: Don't move, I'll get the bug off you.

examples.zh: 路上小心,别开太快。
examples.pinyin: Lùshang xiǎoxīn, bié kāi tài kuài.
examples.en: Be careful on the road, don't drive too fast.

examples.zh: 别灰心,失败是成功之母。
examples.pinyin: Bié huīxīn, shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ.
examples.en: Don't lose heart, failure is the mother of success.

examples.zh: 你别老是看手机,陪我说说话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎoshì kàn shǒujī, péi wǒ shuōshuo huà.
examples.en: Stop always looking at your phone, talk with me.

examples.zh: 别哭了,有什么事我们一起解决。
examples.pinyin: Bié kū le, yǒu shénme shì wǒmen yìqǐ jiějué.
examples.en: Stop crying, whatever it is, we'll solve it together.

examples.zh: 这个决定很重要,你别太快下结论。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng hěn zhòngyào, nǐ bié tài kuài xià jiélùn.
examples.en: This decision is important, don't jump to conclusions.

examples.zh: 你先别走,我有话跟你说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié zǒu, wǒ yǒu huà gēn nǐ shuō.
examples.en: Don't leave yet, I have something to tell you.

examples.zh: 天气冷,你别忘了多穿件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì lěng, nǐ bié wàng le duō chuān jiàn yīfu.
examples.en: It's cold, don't forget to wear an extra layer.

examples.zh: 别担心钱的事,我来想办法。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxīn qián de shì, wǒ lái xiǎng bànfǎ.
examples.en: Don't worry about money, I'll figure something out.

examples.zh: 你别对自己太苛刻了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié duì zìjǐ tài kēkè le.
examples.en: Don't be too hard on yourself.

examples.zh: 别相信那些骗人的广告。
examples.pinyin: Bié xiāngxìn nàxiē piàn rén de guǎnggào.
examples.en: Don't believe those deceptive ads.

examples.zh: 我们说好了,以后谁也别提这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shuōhǎo le, yǐhòu shéi yě bié tí zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: We agreed no one will ever mention this again.

title: "一边...一边..." ile aynı anda iki iş
pattern: 一边 + Fiil 1 (，) 一边 + Fiil 2
summary: "一边...一边..." (yìbiān...yìbiān...) iki eylemin aynı anda yapıldığını anlatır: 他一边走一边唱 = O hem yürüyor hem şarkı söylüyor.
explanation: İki eylemin AYNI ANDA yapıldığını belirtmek için her fiilin önüne "一边" konur: 一边吃饭一边看电视 (hem yemek yerken hem televizyon izlemek). İki eylem de aynı özne tarafından, eş zamanlı yapılır. Konuşmada "边...边..." kısa biçimi de kullanılır: 边走边说. Genellikle biri ana, diğeri ona eşlik eden eylemdir.

examples.zh: 他喜欢一边喝咖啡一边看报纸。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yìbiān hē kāfēi yìbiān kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.en: He likes to read the newspaper while drinking coffee.

examples.zh: 别一边走路一边看手机,很危险。
examples.pinyin: Bié yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān kàn shǒujī, hěn wēixiǎn.
examples.en: Don't look at your phone while walking, it's dangerous.

examples.zh: 她一边做饭一边跟我聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān zuòfàn yìbiān gēn wǒ liáotiān.
examples.en: She chats with me while cooking.

examples.zh: 孩子一边哭一边跑向妈妈。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yìbiān kū yìbiān pǎo xiàng māma.
examples.en: The child ran toward mom while crying.

examples.zh: 我们一边散步一边讨论工作上的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān sànbù yìbiān tǎolùn gōngzuò shàng de shì.
examples.en: We discussed work matters while taking a walk.

examples.zh: 他一边听音乐一边写作业。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān tīng yīnyuè yìbiān xiě zuòyè.
examples.en: He does homework while listening to music.

examples.zh: 老师一边讲课一边在黑板上写字。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yìbiān jiǎngkè yìbiān zài hēibǎn shàng xiězì.
examples.en: The teacher writes on the board while lecturing.

examples.zh: 她一边流泪一边笑,不知道是伤心还是高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān liúlèi yìbiān xiào, bù zhīdào shì shāngxīn háishì gāoxìng.
examples.en: She was crying and smiling at once, unclear if sad or happy.

examples.zh: 我一边吃早饭一边看新闻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìbiān chī zǎofàn yìbiān kàn xīnwén.
examples.en: I watch the news while eating breakfast.

examples.zh: 工人们一边唱歌一边干活,气氛很好。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen yìbiān chànggē yìbiān gànhuó, qìfēn hěn hǎo.
examples.en: The workers sang while working, the atmosphere was great.

examples.zh: 他一边开车一边跟乘客说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān kāichē yìbiān gēn chéngkè shuōhuà.
examples.en: He talks with passengers while driving.

examples.zh: 我常常一边泡脚一边看书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yìbiān pàojiǎo yìbiān kànshū.
examples.en: I often read while soaking my feet.

examples.zh: 她一边收拾房间一边哼着歌。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān shōushi fángjiān yìbiān hēngzhe gē.
examples.en: She hums a song while tidying the room.

examples.zh: 我们一边喝茶一边聊起了往事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān hē chá yìbiān liáo qǐ le wǎngshì.
examples.en: We talked about old times while drinking tea.

examples.zh: 他一边打游戏一边吃薯片。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān dǎ yóuxì yìbiān chī shǔpiàn.
examples.en: He eats chips while playing games.

examples.zh: 妈妈一边织毛衣一边看电视剧。
examples.pinyin: Māma yìbiān zhī máoyī yìbiān kàn diànshìjù.
examples.en: Mom knits a sweater while watching TV dramas.

examples.zh: 我们一边走一边欣赏路边的风景。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān zǒu yìbiān xīnshǎng lùbiān de fēngjǐng.
examples.en: We enjoyed the roadside scenery as we walked.

examples.zh: 他一边工作一边照顾生病的母亲。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān gōngzuò yìbiān zhàogù shēngbìng de mǔqīn.
examples.en: He works while caring for his sick mother.

examples.zh: 孩子一边玩水一边笑个不停。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yìbiān wán shuǐ yìbiān xiào ge bù tíng.
examples.en: The child laughs nonstop while playing with water.

examples.zh: 她一边做笔记一边认真地听。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān zuò bǐjì yìbiān rènzhēn de tīng.
examples.en: She takes notes while listening carefully.

examples.zh: 我们一边等车一边商量周末的计划。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān děngchē yìbiān shāngliang zhōumò de jìhuà.
examples.en: We discussed weekend plans while waiting for the bus.

examples.zh: 他一边跑步一边听英语,一举两得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān pǎobù yìbiān tīng Yīngyǔ, yìjǔliǎngdé.
examples.en: He listens to English while running, killing two birds with one stone.

examples.zh: 她一边照顾孩子一边完成了学业。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbiān zhàogù háizi yìbiān wánchéng le xuéyè.
examples.en: She finished her studies while raising a child.

examples.zh: 我们一边吃火锅一边聊到了半夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān chī huǒguō yìbiān liáodào le bànyè.
examples.en: We ate hot pot and chatted until midnight.

examples.zh: 他总是一边工作一边思考更好的办法。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì yìbiān gōngzuò yìbiān sīkǎo gèng hǎo de bànfǎ.
examples.en: He always thinks of better methods while working.

title: "多" ile derece sorusu
summary: "多" (duō) bir sıfatın önüne gelerek derece/ölçü sorar: 你多高？ = Boyun kaç? (ne kadar uzun?)
explanation: Bir özelliğin derecesini sormak için sıfatın önüne "多" konur: 多高 (ne kadar uzun/boy kaç), 多大 (kaç yaşında/ne kadar büyük), 多远 (ne kadar uzak), 多长 (ne kadar uzun/süre). Genellikle sıfatın olumlu/büyük ucu kullanılır (uzaklık için 多远, kısalık için değil). Cevapta somut bir ölçü verilir. "有多..." biçimi de yaygındır: 你知道它有多重吗?

examples.zh: 你今年多大了？看起来很年轻。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīnnián duō dà le? Kàn qǐlái hěn niánqīng.
examples.en: How old are you this year? You look young.

examples.zh: 从你家到学校有多远？
examples.pinyin: Cóng nǐ jiā dào xuéxiào yǒu duō yuǎn?
examples.en: How far is it from your home to school?

examples.zh: 这座桥有多长,你知道吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo yǒu duō cháng, nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.en: Do you know how long this bridge is?

examples.zh: 你孩子现在多高了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ háizi xiànzài duō gāo le?
examples.en: How tall is your child now?

examples.zh: 这个箱子有多重？我一个人搬不动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi yǒu duō zhòng? Wǒ yí ge rén bān bu dòng.
examples.en: How heavy is this box? I can't move it alone.

examples.zh: 你打算在这里待多久？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zài zhèlǐ dāi duōjiǔ?
examples.en: How long do you plan to stay here?

examples.zh: 这条河有多深,能游泳吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yǒu duō shēn, néng yóuyǒng ma?
examples.en: How deep is this river, can you swim in it?

examples.zh: 你知道这件事有多重要吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhè jiàn shì yǒu duō zhòngyào ma?
examples.en: Do you know how important this is?

examples.zh: 这个房间有多大,够我们住吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān yǒu duō dà, gòu wǒmen zhù ma?
examples.en: How big is this room, is it enough for us?

examples.zh: 你猜猜这棵树有多高。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cāicai zhè kē shù yǒu duō gāo.
examples.en: Guess how tall this tree is.

examples.zh: 从这里到山顶还有多远的路？
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào shāndǐng háiyǒu duō yuǎn de lù?
examples.en: How much farther is it from here to the summit?

examples.zh: 你知道他为了这个目标付出了多大的努力吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā wèile zhège mùbiāo fùchū le duō dà de nǔlì ma?
examples.en: Do you know how much effort he put into this goal?

examples.zh: 这条路多宽,能过两辆车吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù duō kuān, néng guò liǎng liàng chē ma?
examples.en: How wide is this road, can two cars pass?

examples.zh: 你每天睡多久？看你总是很困。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān shuì duōjiǔ? Kàn nǐ zǒngshì hěn kùn.
examples.en: How long do you sleep each day? You always seem sleepy.

examples.zh: 这件事对他来说有多难,只有他自己知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì duì tā lái shuō yǒu duō nán, zhǐyǒu tā zìjǐ zhīdào.
examples.en: Only he knows how hard this is for him.

examples.zh: 你的行李有多重,超重了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xíngli yǒu duō zhòng, chāozhòng le ma?
examples.en: How heavy is your luggage, is it overweight?

examples.zh: 你想要多大的房子？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yào duō dà de fángzi?
examples.en: How big a house do you want?

examples.zh: 你知道等一个人有多辛苦吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào děng yí ge rén yǒu duō xīnkǔ ma?
examples.en: Do you know how hard it is to wait for someone?

examples.zh: 这块布有多长,够做一件衣服吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù yǒu duō cháng, gòu zuò yí jiàn yīfu ma?
examples.en: How long is this cloth, is it enough for a garment?

examples.zh: 你觉得学好一门语言需要多长时间？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde xuéhǎo yì mén yǔyán xūyào duō cháng shíjiān?
examples.en: How long do you think it takes to master a language?

examples.zh: 这个孩子多聪明,你跟他说一次就会了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi duō cōngming, nǐ gēn tā shuō yí cì jiù huì le.
examples.en: How smart this child is — tell him once and he gets it.

examples.zh: 你多久没回家看看父母了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duōjiǔ méi huíjiā kànkan fùmǔ le?
examples.en: How long has it been since you visited your parents?

examples.zh: 这次旅行要花多少钱,你算过吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng yào huā duōshao qián, nǐ suànguò ma?
examples.en: How much will this trip cost, have you calculated?

examples.zh: 你知道健康有多重要,失去了才明白。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào jiànkāng yǒu duō zhòngyào, shīqù le cái míngbai.
examples.en: You realize how important health is only after losing it.

examples.zh: 这道题多简单,你怎么会做错？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí duō jiǎndān, nǐ zěnme huì zuòcuò?
examples.en: How simple this question is — how did you get it wrong?

title: "一样" ile temel karşılaştırma
pattern: İsim 1 + 跟 / 和 + İsim 2 + 一样 (+ Sıfat)
summary: "A 跟/和 B 一样" (yíyàng) iki şeyin aynı/eşit olduğunu belirtir: 我跟他一样高 = Ben onunla aynı boydayım.
explanation: İki şeyin eşitliğini/benzerliğini belirtmek için "A + 跟/和 + B + 一样" kalıbı kullanılır: 这本书跟那本一样 (bu kitap şununla aynı). Sonuna bir sıfat eklenerek hangi açıdan aynı olduğu belirtilir: 一样高 (aynı boyda), 一样贵 (aynı pahalıda). Olumsuzu "不一样" (farklı) veya "跟...不一样". "一样" ayrıca "像...一样" (...gibi) kalıbında benzetme için de kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我跟我哥哥一样高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ gēge yíyàng gāo.
examples.en: I'm the same height as my older brother.

examples.zh: 这两件衣服的颜色一样吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu de yánsè yíyàng ma?
examples.en: Are these two clothes the same color?

examples.zh: 他的想法跟我的完全不一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ gēn wǒ de wánquán bù yíyàng.
examples.en: His idea is completely different from mine.

examples.zh: 这家店的价格和网上的一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de jiàgé hé wǎngshàng de yíyàng.
examples.en: This shop's prices are the same as online.

examples.zh: 她笑起来跟她妈妈一模一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiào qǐlái gēn tā māma yìmúyíyàng.
examples.en: She smiles exactly like her mother.

examples.zh: 每个人的人生都不一样,不用跟别人比。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén de rénshēng dōu bù yíyàng, búyòng gēn biérén bǐ.
examples.en: Everyone's life is different, no need to compare with others.

examples.zh: 这两种方法的效果差不多一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng fāngfǎ de xiàoguǒ chàbuduō yíyàng.
examples.en: The two methods work about equally well.

examples.zh: 他对每个客人都一样热情。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì měi ge kèrén dōu yíyàng rèqíng.
examples.en: He's equally warm to every guest.

examples.zh: 今天的天气跟昨天一样冷。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì gēn zuótiān yíyàng lěng.
examples.en: Today's weather is as cold as yesterday's.

examples.zh: 虽然长得像,但他们的性格很不一样。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhǎng de xiàng, dàn tāmen de xìnggé hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Though they look alike, their personalities are very different.

examples.zh: 这道题的答案跟书上的不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de dá'àn gēn shū shàng de bù yíyàng.
examples.en: The answer to this problem differs from the book's.

examples.zh: 他跟以前不一样了,成熟了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn yǐqián bù yíyàng le, chéngshú le hěn duō.
examples.en: He's different from before, much more mature.

examples.zh: 我们的目标一样,只是方法不同。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de mùbiāo yíyàng, zhǐshì fāngfǎ bùtóng.
examples.en: Our goals are the same, only the methods differ.

examples.zh: 这条裙子跟你上次买的那条一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi gēn nǐ shàng cì mǎi de nà tiáo yíyàng.
examples.en: This skirt is the same as the one you bought last time.

examples.zh: 在我心里,你们两个一样重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ xīnlǐ, nǐmen liǎng ge yíyàng zhòngyào.
examples.en: In my heart, you two are equally important.

examples.zh: 他的中文说得跟本地人一样好。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuō de gēn běndìrén yíyàng hǎo.
examples.en: He speaks Chinese as well as a local.

examples.zh: 这两个城市的生活节奏很不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge chéngshì de shēnghuó jiézòu hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.en: The pace of life in these two cities is very different.

examples.zh: 不管你变成什么样,我对你的爱都一样。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn nǐ biànchéng shénme yàng, wǒ duì nǐ de ài dōu yíyàng.
examples.en: No matter how you change, my love for you stays the same.

examples.zh: 这两支笔看起来一样,其实牌子不同。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhī bǐ kàn qǐlái yíyàng, qíshí páizi bùtóng.
examples.en: These two pens look the same but are actually different brands.

examples.zh: 他做事的态度跟他父亲一样认真。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidu gēn tā fùqīn yíyàng rènzhēn.
examples.en: His work attitude is as serious as his father's.

examples.zh: 我们虽然来自不同的国家,可是笑容是一样的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen suīrán láizì bùtóng de guójiā, kěshì xiàoróng shì yíyàng de.
examples.en: Though we come from different countries, our smiles are the same.

examples.zh: 这次的情况跟上次不太一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de qíngkuàng gēn shàng cì bú tài yíyàng.
examples.en: This situation is a bit different from last time.

examples.zh: 两个孩子虽然是双胞胎,爱好却不一样。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge háizi suīrán shì shuāngbāotāi, àihào què bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Though the two kids are twins, their hobbies differ.

examples.zh: 这个牌子的手机跟那个牌子的质量一样好。
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de shǒujī gēn nàge páizi de zhìliàng yíyàng hǎo.
examples.en: This brand's phone is as good in quality as that brand's.

examples.zh: 无论多少年过去,家乡的味道一直没变,还是一样。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn duōshao nián guòqù, jiāxiāng de wèidào yìzhí méi biàn, háishì yíyàng.
examples.en: No matter how many years pass, the taste of home never changes, still the same.

title: "有点儿" ile "biraz (fazla/olumsuz)"
summary: "有点儿" (yǒudiǎnr) bir sıfattan önce gelerek hafif, genellikle olumsuz bir "biraz fazla" anlamı verir: 有点儿贵 = Biraz pahalı.
explanation: "有点儿" bir sıfatın önüne gelip "biraz, azıcık" der ama neredeyse her zaman İSTENMEYEN/olumsuz bir durumu belirtir: 有点儿累 (biraz yorgun), 有点儿贵 (biraz pahalı). "一点儿"'den farkı önemlidir: "有点儿" sıfattan ÖNCE gelir ve şikâyet tonundadır; "一点儿" ise sıfattan SONRA gelir ve kıyaslama/istek bildirir (便宜一点儿 - biraz daha ucuz). Bu ikisi sık karıştırılır.

examples.zh: 这件衣服有点儿贵,我再看看别的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎnr guì, wǒ zài kànkan biéde.
examples.en: This is a bit expensive, I'll look at others.

examples.zh: 我今天有点儿累,想早点休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎnr lèi, xiǎng zǎodiǎn xiūxi.
examples.en: I'm a little tired today, I want to rest early.

examples.zh: 这道菜有点儿咸,你少放点盐吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yǒudiǎnr xián, nǐ shǎo fàng diǎn yán ba.
examples.en: This dish is a bit salty, use less salt.

examples.zh: 他今天看起来有点儿不高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān kàn qǐlái yǒudiǎnr bù gāoxìng.
examples.en: He looks a bit unhappy today.

examples.zh: 这个房间有点儿小,住两个人不太方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, zhù liǎng ge rén bú tài fāngbiàn.
examples.en: This room is a bit small, not convenient for two people.

examples.zh: 我有点儿担心他一个人在外面。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒudiǎnr dānxīn tā yí ge rén zài wàimiàn.
examples.en: I'm a little worried about him being outside alone.

examples.zh: 今天的天气有点儿冷,你多穿点。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, nǐ duō chuān diǎn.
examples.en: The weather is a bit cold today, wear more.

examples.zh: 这个问题有点儿复杂,我需要想一想。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yǒudiǎnr fùzá, wǒ xūyào xiǎng yi xiǎng.
examples.en: This problem is a bit complicated, I need to think.

examples.zh: 他说话有点儿快,我没完全听懂。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà yǒudiǎnr kuài, wǒ méi wánquán tīngdǒng.
examples.en: He speaks a bit fast, I didn't fully catch it.

examples.zh: 我肚子有点儿疼,可能吃坏了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dùzi yǒudiǎnr téng, kěnéng chīhuài le.
examples.en: My stomach hurts a bit, maybe I ate something bad.

examples.zh: 这双鞋有点儿紧,有大一号的吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié yǒudiǎnr jǐn, yǒu dà yí hào de ma?
examples.en: These shoes are a bit tight, is there a size bigger?

examples.zh: 我对这件事有点儿失望。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒudiǎnr shīwàng.
examples.en: I'm a bit disappointed about this.

examples.zh: 他的态度有点儿冷淡,不像以前那么热情了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tàidu yǒudiǎnr lěngdàn, bú xiàng yǐqián nàme rèqíng le.
examples.en: His attitude is a bit cold, not as warm as before.

examples.zh: 这个字有点儿难写,我总是写错。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì yǒudiǎnr nán xiě, wǒ zǒngshì xiěcuò.
examples.en: This character is a bit hard to write, I always get it wrong.

examples.zh: 我最近有点儿忙,可能没时间陪你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn yǒudiǎnr máng, kěnéng méi shíjiān péi nǐ.
examples.en: I've been a bit busy lately, may not have time for you.

examples.zh: 这个消息让我有点儿意外。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi ràng wǒ yǒudiǎnr yìwài.
examples.en: This news is a bit of a surprise to me.

examples.zh: 房间里有点儿乱,你别介意。
examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ yǒudiǎnr luàn, nǐ bié jièyì.
examples.en: The room is a bit messy, don't mind it.

examples.zh: 他今天的表现有点儿反常。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān de biǎoxiàn yǒudiǎnr fǎncháng.
examples.en: His behavior today is a bit unusual.

examples.zh: 我有点儿后悔当初没有听你的话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒudiǎnr hòuhuǐ dāngchū méiyǒu tīng nǐ de huà.
examples.en: I somewhat regret not listening to you back then.

examples.zh: 这段路有点儿远,我们打车去吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lù yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, wǒmen dǎchē qù ba.
examples.en: This distance is a bit far, let's take a taxi.

examples.zh: 我有点儿紧张,毕竟是第一次上台。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng, bìjìng shì dì yī cì shàngtái.
examples.en: I'm a little nervous, after all it's my first time on stage.

examples.zh: 这个价格有点儿高,能不能便宜一点？
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàgé yǒudiǎnr gāo, néng bu néng piányi yìdiǎn?
examples.en: This price is a bit high, can it be a little cheaper?

examples.zh: 听了他的话,我心里有点儿难受。
examples.pinyin: Tīng le tā de huà, wǒ xīnlǐ yǒudiǎnr nánshòu.
examples.en: After hearing his words, I felt a bit upset.

examples.zh: 这本书的字有点儿小,看久了眼睛疼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de zì yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, kàn jiǔ le yǎnjing téng.
examples.en: This book's text is a bit small, my eyes hurt after a while.

examples.zh: 我觉得他刚才的话有点儿过分。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tā gāngcái de huà yǒudiǎnr guòfèn.
examples.en: I think what he just said was a bit too much.

title: "又...又..." ile "hem...hem..."
summary: "又...又..." (yòu...yòu...) aynı öznenin iki özelliğini/eylemini birlikte belirtir: 又高又帅 = Hem uzun hem yakışıklı.
explanation: Bir kişi/nesnenin iki özelliğini ya da iki eş zamanlı eylemini bir arada belirtmek için her birinin önüne "又" konur: 这个西瓜又大又甜 (bu karpuz hem büyük hem tatlı). İki sıfat genellikle aynı yönde olur (ikisi olumlu ya da ikisi olumsuz). Sıfatların yanı sıra fiillerle de kullanılır: 又哭又笑. "一边...一边..."'dan farkı: bu yapı özellik/durum listeler, ille eş zamanlı süreç değil.

examples.zh: 这个西瓜又大又甜,快尝尝。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīguā yòu dà yòu tián, kuài chángchang.
examples.en: This watermelon is big and sweet, try it.

examples.zh: 他又高又帅,难怪那么受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu gāo yòu shuài, nánguài nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.en: He's tall and handsome, no wonder he's so popular.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.en: This restaurant's food is cheap and delicious.

examples.zh: 孩子又哭又闹,妈妈怎么哄都没用。
examples.pinyin: Háizi yòu kū yòu nào, māma zěnme hǒng dōu méiyòng.
examples.en: The child cried and fussed; no soothing worked.

examples.zh: 这条路又窄又暗,晚上最好别走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yòu zhǎi yòu àn, wǎnshang zuìhǎo bié zǒu.
examples.en: This road is narrow and dark, better not walk it at night.

examples.zh: 她做的蛋糕又漂亮又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de dàngāo yòu piàoliang yòu hǎochī.
examples.en: The cake she made is both pretty and tasty.

examples.zh: 这个工作又累又不挣钱,他还是坚持着。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò yòu lèi yòu bù zhèngqián, tā háishì jiānchízhe.
examples.en: This job is tiring and pays little, yet he sticks with it.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息,我又惊又喜。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ yòu jīng yòu xǐ.
examples.en: On hearing this news, I was both surprised and delighted.

examples.zh: 这里的冬天又冷又干,要注意保湿。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dōngtiān yòu lěng yòu gān, yào zhùyì bǎoshī.
examples.en: Winter here is cold and dry, take care to moisturize.

examples.zh: 他又聪明又努力,成功是迟早的事。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu cōngming yòu nǔlì, chénggōng shì chízǎo de shì.
examples.en: He's smart and hardworking, success is just a matter of time.

examples.zh: 这个包又轻又结实,很适合旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bāo yòu qīng yòu jiēshi, hěn shìhé lǚxíng.
examples.en: This bag is light and sturdy, great for travel.

examples.zh: 她又要工作又要带孩子,真的很辛苦。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu yào gōngzuò yòu yào dài háizi, zhēn de hěn xīnkǔ.
examples.en: She has to work and raise a child, it's really hard.

examples.zh: 这道题又长又难,很多人都没做完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yòu cháng yòu nán, hěn duō rén dōu méi zuòwán.
examples.en: This question is long and hard, many didn't finish it.

examples.zh: 他又抽烟又喝酒,身体越来越差。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu chōuyān yòu hējiǔ, shēntǐ yuèláiyuè chà.
examples.en: He smokes and drinks, his health is getting worse.

examples.zh: 这个地方又安静又漂亮,适合养老。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang yòu ānjìng yòu piàoliang, shìhé yǎnglǎo.
examples.en: This place is quiet and beautiful, good for retirement.

examples.zh: 她的字写得又快又好看。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zì xiě de yòu kuài yòu hǎokàn.
examples.en: She writes fast and beautifully.

examples.zh: 这个手机又薄又轻,拿在手里很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī yòu báo yòu qīng, ná zài shǒu lǐ hěn shūfu.
examples.en: This phone is thin and light, comfortable to hold.

examples.zh: 考试前他又紧张又兴奋,一晚上没睡好。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì qián tā yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn, yì wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo.
examples.en: Before the exam he was nervous and excited, sleeping poorly.

examples.zh: 这种水果又酸又甜,很多人都爱吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ yòu suān yòu tián, hěn duō rén dōu ài chī.
examples.en: This fruit is sour and sweet, many people love it.

examples.zh: 他做的决定又快又准,很少出错。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de juédìng yòu kuài yòu zhǔn, hěn shǎo chūcuò.
examples.en: His decisions are quick and accurate, rarely wrong.

examples.zh: 孩子第一天上学又期待又害怕。
examples.pinyin: Háizi dì yī tiān shàngxué yòu qīdài yòu hàipà.
examples.en: On the first day of school the child was both eager and scared.

examples.zh: 这件外套又保暖又好看,值得买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào yòu bǎonuǎn yòu hǎokàn, zhídé mǎi.
examples.en: This coat is warm and stylish, worth buying.

examples.zh: 这个新员工又勤快又有礼貌,大家都喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn yuángōng yòu qínkuài yòu yǒu lǐmào, dàjiā dōu xǐhuan tā.
examples.en: This new employee is diligent and polite, everyone likes him.

examples.zh: 她又会唱歌又会跳舞,是个多才多艺的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòu huì chànggē yòu huì tiàowǔ, shì ge duōcáiduōyì de rén.
examples.en: She can sing and dance, a very talented person.

examples.zh: 分别的那一刻,我们又哭又笑,舍不得放手。
examples.pinyin: Fēnbié de nà yíkè, wǒmen yòu kū yòu xiào, shěbùdé fàngshǒu.
examples.en: At the moment of parting, we cried and laughed, unwilling to let go.

title: "更" ile "daha (fazla)"
summary: "更" (gèng) bir sıfatın önüne gelerek "daha, daha da" karşılaştırması yapar: 更好 = daha iyi.
explanation: "更" bir özelliğin başka bir şeye göre DAHA fazla olduğunu belirtir: 今天更冷 (bugün daha soğuk). Zaten var olan bir özelliğin üstüne bir derece daha ekler — yani karşılaştırılan diğer şeyin de o özelliğe sahip olduğu ima edilir. "更" tek başına ya da "比" karşılaştırmasıyla kullanılabilir: 他比我更高. "还" (hái) de benzer şekilde "daha da" anlamı verebilir ama "更" daha nettir.

examples.zh: 多运动会让你的身体更健康。
examples.pinyin: Duō yùndòng huì ràng nǐ de shēntǐ gèng jiànkāng.
examples.en: More exercise will make your body healthier.

examples.zh: 这样做效果更好,你试试看。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò xiàoguǒ gèng hǎo, nǐ shìshi kàn.
examples.en: Doing it this way works better, give it a try.

examples.zh: 经历了这件事,他变得更成熟了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglì le zhè jiàn shì, tā biàn de gèng chéngshú le.
examples.en: After going through this, he became more mature.

examples.zh: 我想找一个更安静的地方看书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yí ge gèng ānjìng de dìfang kànshū.
examples.en: I want to find a quieter place to read.

examples.zh: 雨越下越大,天也更黑了。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ yuè xià yuè dà, tiān yě gèng hēi le.
examples.en: The rain got heavier and the sky darker.

examples.zh: 她笑起来更漂亮了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiào qǐlái gèng piàoliang le.
examples.en: She looks even prettier when she smiles.

examples.zh: 跟他比,我觉得你的方案更实际。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tā bǐ, wǒ juéde nǐ de fāng'àn gèng shíjì.
examples.en: Compared to his, I think your plan is more practical.

examples.zh: 有了目标,他工作起来更有动力了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le mùbiāo, tā gōngzuò qǐlái gèng yǒu dònglì le.
examples.en: With a goal, he works with more motivation.

examples.zh: 这次的题目比上次更难。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de tímù bǐ shàng cì gèng nán.
examples.en: This time's questions are harder than last time's.

examples.zh: 我更喜欢喝茶,咖啡对我来说太苦了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gèng xǐhuan hē chá, kāfēi duì wǒ lái shuō tài kǔ le.
examples.en: I prefer tea; coffee is too bitter for me.

examples.zh: 这样一说,事情反而更复杂了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng yì shuō, shìqing fǎn'ér gèng fùzá le.
examples.en: Put this way, things got even more complicated.

examples.zh: 这件事让我更加坚定了自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ gèngjiā jiāndìng le zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.en: This made me even more certain of my own view.

examples.zh: 下雪以后,山上的风景更美了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàxuě yǐhòu, shān shàng de fēngjǐng gèng měi le.
examples.en: After the snow, the mountain scenery is even more beautiful.

examples.zh: 我希望明天能过得更好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng míngtiān néng guò de gèng hǎo.
examples.en: I hope tomorrow will be even better.

examples.zh: 这个消息让他更加担心了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi ràng tā gèngjiā dānxīn le.
examples.en: This news made him even more worried.

examples.zh: 努力过后的成功让人更有成就感。
examples.pinyin: Nǔlì guòhòu de chénggōng ràng rén gèng yǒu chéngjiùgǎn.
examples.en: Success after effort brings a greater sense of achievement.

examples.zh: 跟大城市比,我更喜欢小镇的生活。
examples.pinyin: Gēn dà chéngshì bǐ, wǒ gèng xǐhuan xiǎozhèn de shēnghuó.
examples.en: Compared to the big city, I prefer small-town life.

examples.zh: 多睡一会儿,你会觉得精神更好。
examples.pinyin: Duō shuì yíhuìr, nǐ huì juéde jīngshén gèng hǎo.
examples.en: Sleep a bit more and you'll feel more refreshed.

examples.zh: 他解释了以后,我心里更乱了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiěshì le yǐhòu, wǒ xīnlǐ gèng luàn le.
examples.en: After his explanation, I felt even more confused.

examples.zh: 这本书读第二遍的时候感受更深。

examples.zh: 跟别人相处得越久,越觉得他更善良。

examples.en: The longer you get along with him, the kinder he seems.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让我们的感情更深了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒmen de gǎnqíng gèng shēn le.
examples.en: This trip deepened our bond even more.

examples.zh: 有你的支持,我更有信心了。

examples.zh: 改了几个字以后,这句话读起来更顺了。
